jobs.title: Card Growth & Loyalty Product Manager - Global Payment
jobs.description:
ByteDance provides global payment solutions that support smooth and secure payment experiences across its platforms, including TikTok. The Product Manager will lead end-to-end growth, promotions, and loyalty strategy for the consumer digital card business, designing rewards and incentive programs to drive adoption, usage, and retention. The role will also manage campaigns, partnerships, experimentation, KPI measurement, and cross-functional program execution.

Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute end-to-end card growth, promotion, and loyalty strategy focused on online-first rewards, in alignment with our digital-first value proposition
- Own design of cashback structures, reward tiers, campaign mechanics, and incentive policies, reward validity periods, and redemption rules to maximize user engagement while optimizing ROI
- Benchmark against industry best practices from global banks and leading fintechs to create differentiated rewards experiences that drive competitive advantage
- Launch and iterate on targeted acquisition, activation, and retention campaigns across e-commerce and other high-intent consumer touchpoints
- Design segmented campaigns for new users, dormant users, and high-value users to drive continuous growth in MAC and TPV
- Collaborate with product, operations, and payment network partners (such as Stripe, Visa, bank partners) to implement reward program infrastructure and ensure seamless user experience
- Define, track, and report on core business KPIs: monthly active cards (MAC), total payment volume (TPV), activation rate, retention rate, reward redemption rate, and program ROI
- Build data-driven experimentation frameworks to A/B test program features, campaign creatives, and incentive structures, iterating rapidly to maximize performance
- Conduct regular cohort analysis to identify high-value user segments and optimize reward allocation to maximize returns on marketing spend
- Collaborate with commercial teams to align card benefits with merchant partner offerings, creating exclusive rewards that drive usage
- Work with risk, finance, and compliance teams to ensure all programs adhere to regulatory requirements and financial sustainability targets
- Manage relationships with payment networks and bank partners to leverage joint promotion opportunities

Skills:
- 5+ years of experience in card marketing, loyalty program management, or payments growth roles at a bank, fintech, or consumer internet company with a focus on card growth and launches
- Proven track record of designing and launching customer-facing rewards or cashback programs that drove measurable growth in card usage, active users, or TPV
- Strong data analysis skills, with experience using data to inform strategy, measure program performance, and optimize ROI
- Previous experience at a digital bank or regional banks or leading fintech
- Deep understanding of online-first reward mechanics, e-commerce promotions, and digital payment user behavior
- Experience managing end-to-end P&L for card programs or loyalty products
- Hands-on experience working with payment networks (Visa, Mastercard, Stripe) and card issuing partners
- Experience building and optimizing loyalty programs for consumer-facing digital products at scale
- Strong cross-functional stakeholder management experience, with ability to align product, engineering, compliance, and commercial teams toward shared growth goals

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

We are building a first-of-its-kind consumer mobile product from the ground up. As a Product Manager, you'll be assigned a specific feature area to own end-to-end the exact scope will be defined based on team needs and your background, and shared in more detail during the interview process from spec to shipped feature to the metrics that tell you whether it worked. There is no legacy roadmap and no bloated process to inherit just a zero-to-one build, a small high-output team, and an AI-native way of working that lets one person do the job that used to take three.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is as comfortable in a technical design review as they are in a user research readout. You'll work directly with engineering, design, and outside partners to turn ambiguous ideas into requirements an engineering team can actually build against.

The Product

You will help build the features millions of users actually touch inside a new mobile consumer product anchored around the MrBeast audience. This isn't a passive content app it's a highly interactive platform built to turn the world's largest audience into an engaged community at global scale. Further details shared during the interview process.


What You'll Do

Own the product lifecycle for a specific feature area of the app (to be assigned based on team needs) from opportunity sizing and requirements through launch and post-launch iteration translating ambiguous creative and business goals into clear, testable specs engineering can build against.Write and maintain product requirements, acceptance criteria, and gap analyses that hold up under real engineering and QA scrutiny not just slide decks.Partner daily with engineering leads and designers in tight iteration loops; be in the details of the build, not just the roadmap.Use AI tools as a default part of how you work from drafting specs and synthesizing research to prototyping flows and querying data so your output is materially faster than a traditional PM's.Bring an AI-first product lens to the roadmap itself: identify where AI can improve the member experience (personalization, matchmaking, moderation, content generation, support) and turn those ideas into shippable specs.Define and track the metrics that matter activation, retention, conversion and use them to prioritize ruthlessly.Navigate compliance-sensitive product areas (age-based eligibility, data privacy, sweepstakes/prize mechanics) by translating legal and policy guidance into concrete product rules.Coordinate cross-functionally with external partners and vendors (carrier, platform, and studio partners) to keep technical integrations and contractual commitments on track.Represent the voice of the member: use research, data, and direct product sense to push back on ideas that won't hold up at scale.


Who You Are

Experienced Operator: You have 5+ years of product management experience, including shipping consumer-facing mobile products (iOS/Android or cross-platform) from concept to production at meaningful scale.Technical: You're fluent enough in APIs, data models, and system architecture to ask sharp, informed questions in technical design reviews, understand tradeoffs engineers raise, and know when a "quick fix" isn't. You don't need to write production code or technical specs yourself, but you understand the systems well enough to hold your own in the conversation.AI-First: You already build AI into your daily workflow using AI tools for research synthesis, spec drafting, prototyping, or data analysis and you actively look for AI-driven opportunities in the products you own, not just process shortcuts.Structured Thinker: You can take a messy, ambiguous problem (a creative brief, a legal checklist, a partner requirement) and turn it into a clear, sequenced set of product requirements with no gaps.Data-Driven: You define success metrics before you build, instrument what you ship, and use the numbers not just instinct to decide what to do next.Scrappy & Scaled: You have the startup instincts to build from zero with a lean team, plus enough exposure to consumer scale to know what breaks when a product hits millions of users.Action-Oriented: You thrive in ambiguity, default to shipping over process, and would rather get a prototype in front of real users than run another round of internal review.


Benefits

The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

Competitive SalaryGenerous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life Insurance Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA) 401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matchingFlexible vacation policy and paid company holidaysCompany-provided technology package Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Overview
Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world.
Microsoft Entra's identity platform secures billions of authentications daily — powering sign-in experiences for consumers, enterprises, and developers worldwide. As customer expectations evolve, developers demand fully branded experiences on their own domains, passwordless authentication, and faster integration without sacrificing security. Simultaneously, Microsoft's own applications are converging on a unified sign-in experience across web, mobile, and desktop.
We are looking for a
Senior Product Manager
with a
strong sense of ownership
and an AI-first mindset to lead the next generation of identity SDKs — defining new product categories that give external developers unprecedented control over their authentication experiences, while also enabling Microsoft's internal app teams to adopt consistent sign-in flows at scale. This is a 0→1 role: you will define, ship, and grow SDK products that don't exist today. You will own outcomes end-to-end — from strategy through execution — and consistently leverage AI to accelerate how developers discover, integrate, and troubleshoot identity.
You will work across external customer scenarios (Entra External ID) and workforce scenarios (Entra ID) including internal first-party scenarios, partnering deeply with platform engineering, UX teams, developer research, and go-to-market to bring new SDK products from concept to adoption.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
Responsibilities
Customer-Hosted Web SDK (0→1):
Customers want their authentication experience to feel like theirs — on their domain, in their design language, with no redirects. Today that level of control requires building from scratch.
Define and deliver the SDK that gives customers complete UX ownership while we handle the security and scale underneath.
Modern Web Authentication Patterns:
Own the SDK strategy for single-page applications and server-rendered web apps.
Define how authentication state, client security models, and browser-based authentication work across modern web frameworks (React, Angular, Next.js, ASP.NET Core).
Unified Sign-In SDK for First-Party Apps:
Own the SDK that enables Microsoft's internal app teams to adopt a consistent, unified sign-in experience across web, mobile, desktop, and browser.
Provide integration guidance and adoption playbooks that unblock first-party adoption at scale.
Developer Onboarding & Golden Paths:
Design the SDK-level onramp for customers adopting Entra External ID for the first time — whether starting greenfield or migrating from another provider.
Create quickstarts and reference architectures that minimize time-to-first-sign-in.
Cross-Platform SDK Architecture & Tooling:
Drive consistency across web, mobile, and server-side SDKs — shared error models, token lifecycle, telemetry, versioning, CLI tooling, IDE integration, and AI-assisted diagnostics.
Ensure the SDK family feels like one product.
Workforce Identity SDK Innovation: Extend SDK thinking into enterprise scenarios — ISV multi-tenant integration, B2B collaboration patterns, Conditional Access-aware SDKs, and API protection patterns for Entra ID.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development OR equivalent experience.
Other Requirements:
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
Preferred Qualifications:
3+ years experience shipping developer platforms, SDKs, or API products used by enterprise or consumer-scale developers.
5+ years experience defining product strategy and driving cross-functional execution across engineering, design, and go-to-market teams.
Track record building 0→1 developer products — not just iterating existing ones — with full end-to-end ownership from strategy to shipping.
AI-first product thinking: experience using AI to fundamentally reshape developer workflows — not just adding AI as a feature.
Deep understanding of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, WebAuthn/passkeys, and modern web security patterns (BFF, SPA security, confidential clients).
Experience driving SDK or platform adoption across large application portfolios — spanning both consumer-scale identity (CIAM) and enterprise workforce scenarios.
Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, influence without direct authority, and communicate complex technical decisions to both engineering and business audiences.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Kikoff is a profitable, high growth FinTech unicorn focused on providing affordable financial tools to help consumers achieve financial security. The Product Manager will be responsible for driving user engagement through data analysis and user insights, collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop and innovate products that empower consumers.

Responsibilities:
- Look deeply at the data and talk to users to find what engages them and create engagement loops using content and experiences that leverage product, comms and alert touch points
- Constantly develop and experiment on experiences and types of content that will keep users hooked
- Drive strategic insights that shape roadmaps for engineering, design and marketing using data and user stories to build conviction
- Explore our data and users to create interesting segments and relevant insights and content to drive a virtuous loop of engagement
- Take direction from leadership regarding the key objectives your team needs to drive, but outline a roadmap with your product team to achieve successful outcomes, together
- Drive the discovery process to form a deep understanding of our users and to uncover the products and features that will best empower those consumers
- Reach beyond instinct alone to capture and analyze the right data to allow you to make the most informed decisions as you continue to evolve your approach
- Champion your products within your team, across the company, and with consumers

- Readiness to roll up your sleeves in all parts of the content journey from copy to setting up comms and product touch points to measuring and interpreting results

- You have empathy for consumers and a passion for solving consumer problems in new and innovative ways
- You feel comfortable in the driver's seat and have a natural way of knowing how to get to the destination, but also know when it's time for others to drive

- You can wear as many hats as necessary including marketer, researcher, interface designer, analyst, and friend

- Current undergraduate and master students or early career professionals with high potential such as from consulting or investment banking
- A passion for solving problems derived from data-driven thinking and user needs
- A futurist who can collaboratively lead a team to build towards a vision
- Highly motivated, curious, and adaptable individuals
- Excellent communication, analytical, and first principles problem-solving skills
- Demonstrated leadership potential and eagerness to learn
- Strategic thinker able to breakdown and organize problems, assess opportunity areas, and develop big ideas and priorities to move the business forward

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Inference
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

Our Values

  • Move Fast: We act with speed and precision, breaking down big challenges into achievable steps.

  • Focus: We complete one goal at a time with care, collaborating as a team to deliver features with precision.

  • Balance: Sustained performance comes from rest and recovery. We ensure a healthy work-life balance to keep you at your best.

  • Craftsmanship: Innovation through excellence. Every detail matters, and we take pride in mastering our craft.

  • Minimal: Simplicity drives our innovation. We eliminate complexity through discipline and focus on what truly matters.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager focused on Inference who can drive Lightning's self-serve adoption across thousands of new developers each week. This is a unique opportunity to blend consumer product thinking, growth experimentation, and deep empathy for technical users into a single role.

You'll own the end-to-end journey of helping developers discover, try, and activate on Lightning AI. From optimizing sign-up flows and onboarding, to scaling A/B tests, to designing delightfully fast feedback loops you'll work across product, engineering, design, and data to make Lightning feel magical from the first click.

You will be joining the Product Team and report to our Senior Director of Product. This is a hybrid role based in our New York City or San Francisco office with in-office requirements of 2 days per week. The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $210,000.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and execute growth levers across activation, retention, and referral
  • Lead experiments across onboarding, sign-up flows, pricing pages, and messaging
  • Deep empathy for technical users and an understanding of developer needs, docs, APIs, and integration pain points
  • "Learning to see" so that you can design intuitive user flows and coach an engineering team to ship higher quality products faster and drive adoption that remains in line with our brand guidelines.
  • Collaborate with design and engineering to rapidly test hypotheses
  • Use data to uncover friction in the developer journey and remove it
  • Partner with marketing and community teams to drive traffic, increase activation, and build viral loops via docs, tutorials, and forums
  • Track and move metrics like DAU/MAU, Time to value, Activation %, PQLs, and expansion revenue
  • Build with speed learning from failure, doubling down on what works

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years of product management experience in high-growth, fast-paced environments, 2+ years in consumer/developer products with a trial to paid motion
  • Bias for action and shipping, paired with the ability to think strategically
  • Proven track record running A/B tests and using data to drive decisions
  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable with product instrumentation, metrics, and dashboards
  • A sincere curiosity for the AI/ML space that enable you to go deep into the technical subject matter in order to better understand our customers and their challenges
  • Excellent product judgment and a feel for what makes UX "click"
  • Demonstrates a strong willingness to learn, adapt, and improve by actively seeking and applying feedback from peers, leaders, and customers. Able to adjust approaches based on constructive criticism to drive personal and team growth.
  • Comfortable with technical concepts and able to work closely with engineering teams to define product specifications and address technical challenges. Direct experience with model training and inference is a plus.
  • Have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Bonus: Experience with growth loops, referrals, pricing experiments, or viral acquisition

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:
$160,000—$275,000 USD

Benefits and Perks

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well-being, and long-term success. Benefits may vary by location, team, and role.

Benefits include:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage (U.S.); Private medical and dental insurance (U.K.)
  • Retirement and financial wellness support (U.S.); Pension contribution (U.K.)
  • Generous paid time off, plus holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Professional development support
  • Wellness and work-from-home stipends
  • Flexible work environment

At Lightning AI, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and create better products. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are dedicated to building a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute to their fullest potential.

- Experience with securitization and capital markets

jobs.title: Product Manager, Mobile Apps
jobs.description:
In 2026, we launched Computer, the defining product for the new era of agentic AI. We’ve scaled beyond the millions of people using Perplexity every day for research, shopping, investing and curiosity into a new paradigm of using AI to transform knowledge into action.
Product Managers at Perplexity work closely with design and engineering, focusing on the native mobile experiences that bring agentic AI and search into people’s everyday lives. The ideal candidate should have strong communication and writing skills, the ability to envision innovative technology, and a willingness to reimagine work to be more efficient and creative. Ideal candidates have deep experience building exceptional mobile products: in the application, please highlight the mobile apps or platform experiences you are most proud of shipping.
The Role
The Mobile Apps team owns the end-to-end Perplexity experience across iOS and Android. This includes how users discover and onboard into the product, search and take action on the go, use voice, camera, notifications, widgets, and other native capabilities, manage subscriptions and preferences, and return to ongoing work across devices.
You will identify the highest-leverage mobile user problems, translate them into clear product direction, and partner closely with design, engineering, data science, and research to deliver experiences that feel fast, intuitive, cohesive, and dependable. This role requires strong product judgment, deep user empathy, analytical rigor, fluency in mobile platform constraints and opportunities, and an exceptional eye for detail.
What You'll Do
Anticipate opportunities for innovation and value in how people use AI on mobile.
Envision new mobile experiences and deliver a long-term vision across iOS and Android.
Understand the levers for mobile product-led growth, engagement, and retention.
Work closely with engineering and design to align product expectations with native platform capabilities and constraints.
Work with research to evaluate and steer nondeterministic models into high-value outcomes for mobile users.
Have conviction to make difficult product decisions in the face of uncertainty.
Develop a deep understanding of mobile user needs, behaviors, and friction through direct product use, qualitative research, product data, and experimentation.
Make complex AI behavior understandable and controllable on small screens through clear interaction models, thoughtful defaults, and well-designed feedback.
Drive alignment when improvements span iOS, Android, web, backend systems, or multiple teams.
Communicate product decisions, tradeoffs, progress, and learnings clearly to leadership and cross-functional partners.
Qualifications
Strong experience with product management and leadership.
Strong experience working with data and metrics.
Experience shipping and scaling high-quality consumer mobile products across iOS or Android.
Deep understanding of native mobile interaction patterns, platform capabilities, performance, and reliability.
Experience with rapid mobile prototyping, experimentation, and data visualization.
Experience building data-driven flywheels for iterative improvement.
Thrives in a small, agile team: has initiative and desire for ownership.
4+ years of product management experience.
Our Mission
Perplexity's mission is to power curiosity. Curious people are the people who drive change in the world. Driving change is a continuous cycle of learning, building, and integrating.
Learn: curious people constantly learn new things by asking more. They question the status quo in their own expertise and they constantly learn outside of it. Research is essential to them and never ending.
Build: curious people make and create things, to show the world their new answers to problems no one else ever questioned. They take action on what they've learned. Makers need tools to create their products, their companies, their reality.
Integrate: they must interact with the world as it is to drive change and adoption. True leaders do not simply build something and hope. They must have armies of agents and workers who can constantly work in millions of small ways.
Repeat. For curious people this is a cycle that never ends.

Compensation: $230K - $330K

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
At Adobe, our vision is to reimagine and evolve the network connecting our users. We aim to make it the premier hub for all our customers, from everyday creators to industry luminaries. We’re searching for a hard-working, proactive Senior Product Manager to spearhead this initiative alongside our Community Product and cross-functional teams. Adobe’s community platform and product already serves millions of people every month and you will be at the forefront to further grow and expand our offering.
Join us and play a pivotal role in reshaping the digital landscape of online communities for creators.
What you'll do
Be the voice for a diverse spectrum of Adobe’s user base, from seasoned professionals to newcomers, ensuring we cater to their outstanding needs and aspirations.
Guide the product philosophy, defining specific product objectives, key results and driving the roadmap for a modern community experience tailored to creators and creatives.
Collaborate with engineers, designers, researchers, program managers, community specialists and data scientists to bring innovative and delightful community features to life.
Understand the dynamics of our current community platform, bringing data to bear to compose improvements and improve engagement. Your role will involve diving deep into data analytics, from gathering relevant metrics to deriving insights that propel our product strategy forward.
Prioritize features and navigate them through the entire product cycle, from conception to launch, ensuring every step aligns with Adobe’s quality standard and vision for community.
Work alongside engineering and program management to establish timelines, ensure that projects are well-defined, prioritized, and completed on schedule.
Lead and influence cross-functional teams, encouraging collaboration and ensuring alignment across departments to achieve product objectives.
What
you'll need to succeed

jobs.title: Product Manager, Link Growth [Consumer]
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.
Plaid’s Consumer team owns all of Plaid’s consumer facing surfaces. This includes Link, Plaid’s flagship product, which has been used by over half of all US adults to share their information safely and securely with financial applications. Link drives the vast majority of Plaid’s revenue. We’re also building out Plaid’s first B2C product, which is an exciting, 0-1 space for us. Both areas are top business priorities.
Responsibilities
As the Link Growth PM, you will own conversion at Plaid and evolve it for a growingly agentic world. Link is the front door to Plaid’s products, so this is a meaningfully large responsibility: (1) Any improvement in Link conversion has direct revenue impact, and (2) We’re seeing a massive uptick in AI-companies launching fintech products, so making Link compatible for their use cases is one of our highest priorities.
You will define the roadmap for the above and partner with cross-functional team to hit your goals:
• Drive prioritization and execution (build, measure, iterate)
• Identify opportunities through consumer feedback and staying close to our data / dashboards
• Partner with cross-functional team (design, research, data science, ML, legal, and compliance) to do all of the above
Qualifications
5+ years in product management, building consumer onboarding, growth, or related products, shipping consumer-facing changes
You have successfully launched consumer facing features through rapid experimentation driving meaningful outcomes in the user journey and represented via metrics
You can communicate complex concepts succinctly for broad audiences to drive decisions
You have driven roadmap and prioritization exercises and shown that you have driven clear impact through your decisions
Other things that matter
You thrive in a culture of high ownership, velocity, and throughput, and speak your mind regardless of level
You have a strong opinion on both UX and data
Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

jobs.title: Product Manager Growth - San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
Who we are

In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people - but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology. We believe in the joy of serving others, and that's why we created Otter – to help restaurateurs succeed in online food delivery. Restaurants around the world, both large and small, including Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry’s, KFC, and Eataly trust our software to power their delivery business. We increase sales, reduce order issues, and decrease delivery headaches.

What you’ll do

As Product Manager for Product-Led Growth (PLG), you’ll own the roadmap for how Otter grows through the product itself. This role is focused on building a self-serve growth engine that improves acquisition, activation, monetization, and retention. You will:

  • Design and run experiments to improve funnel efficiency, reduce CAC, and increase conversion from lead → customer → expansion.
  • Build features and flows that generate organic growth.
  • Drive monetization through pricing experiments, upsell opportunities, and CRM-driven campaigns that expand LTV.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Data Science to enrich leads, improve attribution, and optimize channels.
  • Define and track success metrics – CAC, LTV, conversion rates, activation velocity, and self-serve revenue.
  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, design, and GTM to ship fast, learn quickly, and scale what works.

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of product management or relevant experience.
  • Proven track record of building and scaling growth-focused product experiences.
  • Strong quantitative skills: comfortable with SQL, experimentation, and growth modeling.
  • Creative problem solver with a bias toward fast learning and iteration.
  • Excellent communicator who can align GTM, data, and product teams around a shared growth roadmap.
  • Bonus: experience in SaaS, marketplaces, or restaurant/commerce technology.

Why join us

  • Growing market: You’ll be focused on an $80 billion market that’s projected to reach at least $500 billion by 2030 in the US alone.
  • Industry transformation: You’ll be part of a team redefining how restaurants run both online and offline.
  • Impact at scale: What you build will directly power thousands of restaurants and millions of diners.
  • Collaborative environment: You’ll work closely with talented colleagues across teams, with the support and guidance to grow your career.

What else you need to know

This role is based in our San Francisco office. We believe the best ideas and fastest progress happen when we’re together, so this is an in-office role five days a week.

The base salary range for this role is $195,000 - $246,000 per year.

Actual compensation will be determined on an individual basis and may vary depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package. You may also be eligible for equity awards and an annual performance-based bonus.

Benefits Summary (USA Full-Time Exempt Employees):

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plans, incl. HSA options)
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance (short- and long-term)
  • Voluntary insurance: accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity
  • Optional supplemental life insurance for self, spouse, and children
  • Pet insurance discount
  • 401(k)
  • Time Off policies:
    • Discretionary vacation days
    • 8 paid holidays per year
    • Paid sick time
    • Paid Bereavement leave
    • Paid Parental Leave
    • Health Savings Account (HSA)
    • Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter)

Benefits are subject to change at the company's discretion.
Atoms accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Array is a financial innovation platform that helps digital brands and financial institutions launch consumer products faster. As a Senior Product Manager, you will define product strategy and optimize the front-end experience to enhance conversion rates and user engagement.

Responsibilities:
- Own and optimize the front-end experience of the product, with a focus on increasing conversion rates and user engagement
- Drive improvements in user onboarding and application flows, ensuring the best possible experience for customers
- Analyze user feedback and data to make informed decisions that enhance product performance and drive higher conversion
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between business needs, user expectations, and product goals
- Develop and implement initiatives to improve customer acquisition and retention, focusing on organic growth and return on spend
- Build a cohesive strategy to optimize the B2B2C product journey, maximizing the effectiveness of both business and consumer touchpoints
- Partner with other Product Managers and engineering teams to develop a compelling vision, strategy, and roadmap
- Work with product and engineering to clarify, triage, and prioritize bugs
- Assess risk and come up with well thought out solutions to eliminate any roadblocks for the team in accomplishing tasks on the product roadmap
- Maintain a habit of using AI tools to think, build, and ship faster—it's your default, not an afterthought

Skills:
- 6+ years of experience in a technically focused product management role; experience building products that shipped to market
- Strong technical background: Computer Science or software engineering experience would be great; must have experience writing in SQL and synthesizing data on your own
- Experience managing a consumer-facing app or product, with a focus on front-end conversion rate optimization
- Proven ability to grow key user metrics (e.g., users, monthly active users) through specific initiatives related to onboarding or user flow
- Expertise in managing product experiences for D2C or B2B2C models, with a focus on improving user-facing interactions
- Familiarity with identifying and addressing barriers to conversion and making data-driven decisions to boost performance
- Ability to understand and navigate B2B2C complexities, balancing the needs of both business partners and end users
- Strong understanding of consumer company metrics such as CAC, conversion rate, and ROI, with experience avoiding excessive reliance on paid ad spend
- A belief that AI is reshaping work, you instinctively use it to accelerate everything you do

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
Hex is a growth-stage company seeking a Senior Product Manager, Growth to join its Growth & Monetization group. The role owns the trial-to-paid funnel and seat expansion roadmap, leads cross-functional growth initiatives, and uses quantitative analysis and customer insights to drive measurable business impact.

Responsibilities:
- Own the trial-to-paid funnel. Obsess over conversion from trial to purchase, whether by a self-serve checkout or sales-assisted land. Understand exactly where users are dropping off, form hypotheses, and ship bets that move the needle across onboarding, activation, checkout, and sales outreach
- Maximize seat expansion. Think deeply about how customers grow on Hex — how new users activate, how paid seats get promoted, and how we reduce contraction. Work with GTM and lifecycle on PLS signals and automation that surfaces the right accounts at the right time
- Run a cross-functional growth pod. Partner with our software engineers, designer, growth marketer, lifecycle marketers, and data team to operate like a startup within Hex. Bring rigor to prioritization, set an ambitious pace for shipping, and keep the team focused on what moves the dial for the business
- Balance quantitative reasoning with product sense. Define the metrics that matter, build dashboards to track them, and close the loop on every experiment we run. Determine when an A/B test is appropriate and when to lean on product sense. Proactively identify opportunities by combining data insights with deep customer empathy

Skills:
- 5+ years of product management and/or growth experience, with a track record of owning and improving business metrics
- Experience at a PLG or PLS company; you understand how product, sales, and growth loops interact
- You think like a business owner: Funnel conversion and revenue growth are outcomes you're accountable for, not just metrics you report on. You run through walls to get the job done
- You understand both sides of growth: the quantitative (how is our churn rate trending?), and the qualitative (why do customers in this segment perceive a mismatch in price-to-value?)
- Excellent communicator — you can distill funnel complexity into a crisp narrative for leadership, and get granular enough to unpack design and implementation details with your eng and design team
- We're a growth-stage startup, so we're looking for someone who can ship quickly, iterate, and thrive in ambiguity
- This role will be hybrid (1-2 days per week in office) out of our NYC or SF office
- Background in data tools, developer tools, or data analytics
- Familiarity with experimentation methodologies and platforms (Eppo, LaunchDarkly)
- Founder or early-stage startup experience

jobs.title: Product Manager | Growth
jobs.description:
About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.
About the Role
As a Product Manager, Growth at Ramp, you’ll drive acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization across our product suite. You’ll identify opportunities to help more businesses discover Ramp, get value from our products, and expand their usage over time.
You’ll work closely with engineers, designers, marketers, and data scientists to develop and execute a growth strategy grounded in customer insight and experimentation. Your scope will include core product experiences and partner-led growth channels, with ownership from identifying an opportunity through launching, measuring, and scaling solutions.
You’ll identify opportunities to use AI to help businesses discover relevant Ramp products, reach value faster, and expand their usage over time. You’ll balance rapid experimentation with the accuracy, transparency, and customer trust required when building financial products.
Please note that this Product Management role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at one of our NYC or SF offices at least 2 days/week
What You’ll Do
Develop and execute a growth product strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization, helping businesses get more value from Ramp
Own the roadmap, priorities, and execution for a defined growth surface area, from identifying opportunities through launching, measuring, and scaling solutions
Lead the ideation, development, and launch of growth experiences, including AI-powered approaches to onboarding, product discovery, recommendations, and cross-sell
Partner with engineering, design, marketing, and data science to deliver high-impact initiatives across core product experiences and partner-led growth channels
Conduct customer research and analyze product metrics and feedback to understand where finance teams encounter friction and identify opportunities to improve adoption
Define and track growth KPIs, design controlled experiments where feasible, and use results to distinguish incremental impact from underlying trends
Evaluate AI-powered experiences for both growth impact and quality, including accuracy, relevance, and reliability; balance rapid iteration with safeguards for sensitive financial data, transparency, and customer control
Turn successful experiments into durable product improvements and contribute to the practices that help Ramp’s product management function scale
What You Need
BA/BS in mathematics, technical, or analytical field
Minimum 4 years of product management experience, building technical products from ideation to launch
Data-Driven Mindset – Fluency in crafting data-driven narratives. You enjoy writing SQL to answer your own questions and thrive on leveraging data to shape and communicate a strategic vision.
Slope - We value slope over intercept; We’re looking for a high-growth team member who can be a future leader at Ramp
Leadership & Collaboration – Proven ability to build alignment across cross-functional teams, inspire stakeholders, and lead initiatives from strategy through execution.
Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on research and tools.
Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments like Figma and Git.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Commerce
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Role

Twitch's Commerce organization drives over $1B+ in annual payouts to creators through innovative monetization products. As we continue to evolve how streamers earn and how communities engage, we're looking for a visionary Sr. Product Manager to own the roadmap for supporting streamers through interactive, fun, and mobile-native commerce products.

In this role, you will define and execute the strategy for helping streamers build deeper connections with their communities through interactive features and engaging monetization tools. You'll own products like Bits while exploring new ways to help creators earn, engage their audiences, and grow their channels. By focusing on streamer success and community connection, you'll help shape how millions of viewers support their favorite streamers across all devices.

You can work from San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Irvine, CA; or Seattle, WA.

You Will:

  • Lead the product vision and roadmap for interactive commerce products, delivering quick wins while building scalable infrastructure to help creators engage and monetize their communities
  • Own the one-to-two year vision & drive prioritization for interactive features that help streamers connect with viewers, including Bits and future innovations in community engagement and creator monetization
  • Own core streamer success metrics including interaction rates, creator earnings, viewer engagement, mobile conversion, and retention.
  • Continuously run experiments to test new features and improve outcomes for streamers and their communities
  • Drive mobile-first product strategy, ensuring streamers can engage and monetize their communities seamlessly on mobile devices where viewers increasingly spend time
  • Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Research, and Community teams to deliver products that help streamers succeed and grow their channels
  • Champion streamer-first thinking, ensuring all products enhance creator earnings, deepen community bonds, and support channel growth

You Have:

  • 5+ years of work experience as a Product Manager
  • Experience building consumer-facing products at scale, particularly mobile applications or creator/community tools
  • Deep understanding of creator needs, community dynamics, and what helps streamers succeed on digital platforms
  • Experience with monetization products and understanding how to balance creator earnings with viewer experience
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups
  • Experience defining 1-2 year product strategies and executing against ambitious roadmaps
  • Experience with live streaming, gaming, or the broader creator economy

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of mobile app development and mobile-first design principles
  • Familiarity with virtual goods, digital currencies, or in-app purchase systems
  • Knows how to write basic SQL and how to use experimentation/analytics tools
  • Background in social features, chat systems, or real-time interactive experiences
  • Personal experience as a content creator or deep engagement with creator communities

Perks

  • Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Maternity & Parental Leave
  • Flexible PTO
  • Amazon Employee Discount

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Pursuant to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Subscriptions
jobs.description:
OnePay is a consumer fintech company providing an all-in-one financial services platform. The Product Manager will own the day-to-day development of a new subscription product, from initial launch through sustained growth, including user experience, subscription mechanics, go-to-market strategy, optimization, and cross-functional execution.

Responsibilities:
- Own the front-end user experience: signup, account setup, ongoing management
- Build and iterate on subscription management, engagement, and retention mechanics
- Work with engineering to make informed product decisions and ensure their execution
- Drive toward key build and testing milestones ahead of external launch, then shift into post-launch optimization: conversion tuning, segment targeting, expansion to new acquisition channels
- Partner on go-to-market strategy: conversion, retention, and growth
- Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Risk, Customer Operations, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to launch experiences that are clear, compliant, and operationally scalable
- Drive key development, testing, and operational-readiness milestones ahead of launch

Skills:
- 4-7 years of product management experience, ideally building consumer-facing products
- Direct experience on a subscription product: acquisition, retention, and engagement mechanics
- A background in fintech/finance products at scale
- Track record of shipping autonomously at a startup or smaller-scale company
- Strong product judgment and the ability to balance customer experience, business impact, regulatory requirements, and technical complexity
- Drive and proactivity - everyone here is a builder and executor
- A high degree of ownership, initiative, and comfort operating in a fast-moving, highly collaborative environment

The gaps are regulated-product compliance depth and any pre-launch work at a small startup.

About the Role
We are seeking a visionary Senior Product Manager to lead Home, a project tasked with transforming the first moments of every user session within the Bloomberg Terminal into an intelligent, proactive, and conversational experience.
You will lead the shift from manual data retrieval to agent-led analysis. By leveraging modular UI components and agentic skills, you will ensure that every financial professional persona—from a net-new equity analyst to a seasoned portfolio manager—achieves situational preparedness the moment they log in.
As the lead PM for Home, you will develop and execute a product strategy focused on the initial user experience. You will build a foundation that allows Bloomberg domain teams to contribute to a personalized, unified, default entry point designed to get users oriented and productive quickly.
This role sits within our Core Product division and requires close collaboration across cross-functional teams including Engineering, UX, and Data.
We’ll trust you to:
Help define the evolution from a traditional application experience toward more conversational and modular workflows
Partner with engineering and product teams to surface timely, relevant insights that help users stay informed and productive
Collaborate with domain experts across Bloomberg to develop reusable, “agent-aware” product components and experiences
Contribute to the vision for personalization and contextual experiences that adapt to user workflows over time
Support rapid experimentation and prototyping efforts to validate new ideas and improve the user experience iteratively
Act as a connector across teams to help align on interaction patterns, priorities, and long-term platform direction
Define and monitor user engagement and adoption metrics to measure product impact and improve onboarding and workflow efficiency
You’ll need to have:
5+ years of Product Management experience, ideally within financial technology, enterprise software, or workflow-driven platforms
Experience working on AI-enabled, data-rich, or service-oriented products and platforms
Familiarity with personalization, recommendation systems, conversational experiences, or workflow automation concepts
Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, UX, and Data teams
Comfort operating in evolving environments where priorities and opportunities may shift over time
A thoughtful, user-centric approach to solving complex workflow problems
We’d love to see:
An understanding of financial professional workflows and how users consume information throughout the trading or research day
Experience launching MVPs, running experiments, and using feedback loops to shape product direction
Curiosity about AI, conversational interfaces, and the future of intelligent workflow tools
A platform mindset and interest in building scalable, reusable product experiences

jobs.description:
Overview

The MAI Monetization organization powers Microsoft Advertising and the monetization of Microsoft's AI products — spanning Copilot, Bing, and Edge. Our Product team builds AI-native advertising experiences that help advertisers achieve measurable growth through automation, recommendations, objective-based buying, and proprietary signals — while keeping user trust, relevance, and transparency at the center. Advertising is where user intent, marketplace economics, and large-scale AI systems meet, and it is one of the highest-impact surfaces at the company.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Product Manager to drive execution across a high-impact area of our Ads monetization portfolio. You will own products end-to-end — turning direction into crisp requirements, driving prioritization, and partnering day-to-day with Engineering, Design, and Data Science to ship AI-powered experiences that grow revenue while improving quality, relevance, and trust. You will make data-informed decisions, instrument and land the metrics that matter, and keep programs moving from definition through launch.

This role suits a builder — a product manager who thrives close to engineering, is energized by shipping, and turns ambiguity into a concrete, prioritized backlog that teams can execute against.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.  

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.



Job Description

NBCUniversal’s Enterprise Product Team builds products that provide essential capabilities to organizations throughout NBCUniversal. The team leverages deep relationships with our business engagement and engineering counterparts to build cohesive, end-to-end solutions for their clients or users. The product portfolio is aligned around critical NBCU functions such as Content/Title Management, Data & Analytics, Scheduling & Distribution, and Content Sales.

As a part of the Product team, you will be responsible for several products in your department. You will be in constant communication with clients on anything product related, including development progress, deliverables, and timelines. You will lead grooming sessions, and execute product demos, and walkthroughs. You are an expert in your area’s product features, capabilities, and functionality. You will be a consultant on new multi-product initiatives or programs. You will be a mentor to Product Specialists. 

Responsibilities:

Product Lifecycle ManagementManage the end-to-end life cycle of products, from ideation through delivery and ongoing optimization. Define and own overall product vision, strategy, and success metrics for key initiatives, including data warehouse and business intelligence platforms. Roadmap & Backlog OwnershipDevelop and maintain feature roadmaps, prioritizing capabilities based on business needs and strategic goals. Lead grooming sessions to ensure a consistently up-to-date backlog of clearly defined features and user stories. Fully document product features and capabilities in JIRA, including measurable acceptance criteria. Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements GatheringCollaborate across functions (Engineering, Ad Sales, Programming, Operations, Product, Architecture) to capture and analyze requests, define data needs, and align priorities. Translate complex business requirements into actionable product features and conceptual models. Technical Collaboration & Solution DesignPartner with architecture and solutions leaders to identify optimal technical solutions that meet client and business needs. Work closely with engineering teams and vendors to implement automation and workflow optimizations. Data-Driven Product DevelopmentPerform hands-on data exploration and analysis of large datasets to inform product decisions and enable data-driven features. Continually leverage business insights and analytics to refine platform strategy and solve high-impact problems. Quality Assurance & ComplianceDefine and execute user acceptance testing for new features and integrations. Ensure all workflows and vendor deliverables adhere to NBCUniversal standards and industry regulations. Incident & Change ManagementCoordinate resolution of operational issues promptly to minimize disruption. Manage change requests effectively to maintain stability in live environments. Reporting & AnalyticsTrack and report on vendor performance metrics (uptime, error rates, turnaround times). Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve service quality and operational efficiency. Documentation & GovernanceMaintain comprehensive documentation for processes, integrations, and SLAs. Ensure all product and vendor workflows comply with internal standards and regulatory requirements. 

Qualifications

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required. 5+ years of relevant work experience in the technology or media industry. 3+ years’ experience in a role demonstrating strong technical, quantitative, and analytical skills. 3+ years’ experience in a role exhibiting excellent written and oral communications, effective interpersonal skills, project management, and strong formal presentation abilities. 3+ years Product management experience in media, gathering client requirements, writing product and/or technical specifications, working with development teams, and managing product roadmaps as well as launches2+ years of direct client engagement experienceDesired Characteristics:

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

POSITION SUMMARY

As a Senior Product Manager for CoreUX, you'll help bring our mission to life—reinventing the financial system and helping our community members achieve a better financial position. You will be responsible for shaping the experience every EarnIn member has with the app — from the home screen they land on to the design system and platform performance underneath it. You'll help carry CoreUX's shift from a team that supported other product lines to the team accountable for EarnIn's end-to-end app experience, using everything in your product toolkit to architect the product strategy, continually discover new insights, and drive execution. The Mountain View base salary range for this full-time position is $229,000-$280,000, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This is a hybrid position in Mountain View that requires in-office work 2 days a week.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the home screen and core navigation experience, moving it from a static, rule-based surface to one that's ML-orchestrated — showing each member the right next step, whether that's their first Cash Out, a product they haven't discovered yet, or a fix for something broken
  • Create tight feedback loops with our community members and a deep understanding of product issues and the path to resolution across every shared surface CoreUX owns
  • Communicate the product vision, roadmap, and results for CoreUX's app experience, design system, and platform work to your product team, stakeholders, and executive team
  • Define OKRs and set stretch goals for your product and team, in service of company-wide goals like wage access activation and design system adoption
  • Raise the bar for design quality and user experience for our members — partnering closely with Design to enforce and evolve EarnIn's design system across every surface
  • Lead a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, researchers, and data analysts to build and scale the surfaces — home screen, navigation, discovery — that shape how members experience EarnIn as a whole
  • Establish, monitor, and analyze metrics — activation, design system adoption, trust rating, platform performance — to track progress toward product goals
  • Leverage user research, competitive analysis, and data to identify and prioritize new opportunities for cross-surface governance and member experience
  • Champion CoreUX's shift to AI-native operations — building the automated tooling and agents that help us design, build, and catch issues faster — and use AI tools yourself to move faster from insight to spec to shipped experiment
  • Design, develop, and execute features and experiments to iterate your way to the product's success rapidly, partnering with engineering on mobile and web platform delivery

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 4+ years of product management at a consumer technology product company
  • Strong product/design sense developed by shipping delightful and innovative products — you care as much about consistency and craft as you do about growth metrics
  • Strong analytical skills in leveraging data to drive product decisions and improve key metrics
  • Ability to engage in technical discussions and make informed product decisions based on technical constraints, especially around platform performance and design system architecture
  • Deep user empathy and experience building products based on user needs
  • Can confidently create a rapid experimentation culture to accelerate learning and iteration
  • Ability to influence and build alignment across the team — and across other product teams building on shared surfaces — to deliver against goals successfully
  • Ability to think outside the box to solve complex problems with creative and radical ideas
  • Fluent with AI tools in your own workflow — using them to accelerate research synthesis, spec writing, prototyping, and data analysis — and excited to build products that get smarter through AI, not just faster to ship

#LI-Hybrid

A Note on AI in the Hiring Process: EarnIn may use Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered tools during the hiring process, including tools that generate summaries or notes for interviewers, review resumes, assist with scheduling, or help identify themes across candidate responses and profiles for a given role. Final hiring decisions are made by human interviewers and hiring managers. If you have any concerns about the use of AI in our hiring process, please connect with your recruiter. With your consent, EarnIn may use AI tools to help transcribe or summarize interviews. Recordings are treated as confidential candidate data and are accessible only to authorized hiring personnel. Declining to be recorded will not negatively affect your candidacy or evaluation.

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging.
