jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Rush Street Interactive is a market leader in online casino and sports betting, operating real-money gaming brands across multiple markets. The Senior Product Manager leads product initiatives from discovery through measurable business impact, owning stakeholder alignment, problem definition, research, ideation, roadmap creation, and outcome assessment. The role also emphasizes data-driven decision-making, regulatory compliance, responsible gaming, personalization, and collaboration with technology and product delivery teams.

Responsibilities:
- Lead discovery efforts to identify, validate, and prioritize high-impact problems and opportunities
- Develop a deep understanding of user needs, business goals, and operational constraints
- Translate ambiguous inputs into clearly defined problem statements and opportunity spaces
- Own alignment with stakeholders across the business domain, ensuring shared understanding of priorities, tradeoffs, and expected outcomes
- Balance competing stakeholder needs and drive clear prioritization decisions
- Communicate roadmap direction, progress, and outcomes transparently
- Drive ideation of product solutions that address validated problems, in collaboration with Design, Data, and Engineering
- Shape initiatives into well-defined epics, including:
- Clear problem statement and context
- Value hypothesis and expected impact
- Success metrics and measurement approach
- High-level solution direction and scope
- Initial wireframes or conceptual designs where applicable
- Own and maintain the product roadmap for their area, ensuring alignment with company strategy and business priorities
- Prioritize initiatives based on impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance
- Continuously refine the roadmap based on new insights, data, and changing conditions
- Define success metrics for each initiative and ensure proper measurement is in place
- Evaluate the impact of delivered initiatives against expected outcomes
- Take accountability for results, identifying gaps and driving follow-up actions where needed
- Feed learnings back into future discovery and roadmap planning
- Leverage analytics platforms, A/B testing frameworks, and player behavior data to inform product discovery, prioritization, and post-launch evaluation
- Partner with Data and Analytics teams to build dashboards, define KPIs, and establish experimentation practices within your product area
- Use quantitative and qualitative research methods to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes
- Factor regulatory requirements, licensing conditions, and market-specific compliance considerations into product strategy and roadmap decisions
- Champion responsible gaming principles by ensuring product features support player safety and responsible play experiences
- Stay informed on evolving regulations across RSI's operating markets and proactively assess their product implications
- Drive product initiatives that enhance personalization, player engagement, and retention across the platform
- Collaborate with CRM, Marketing, and Data teams to shape tailored player journeys and differentiated offerings
- Advocate for the player experience in all product decisions, ensuring alignment with RSI's mission
- Act as the primary stakeholder for Product Owners and the Product Delivery organization, providing clear, well-defined epics that are ready for delivery planning
- Act as a primary point of contact for the rest of the business, for all their product needs in their respective scope
- Ensure all initiatives meet a high bar of readiness before handoff, including clear problem definition, scope, success metrics, and business context
- Partner with Technology Product Managers to support solution shaping, ensuring alignment between product intent and technical approach
- Collaborate with Product Owners during delivery planning to clarify intent, resolve ambiguities, and support prioritization decisions
- Maintain focus on outcomes and business intent during delivery, without owning or managing execution details or team-level processes
- Stay available throughout delivery to answer questions, validate assumptions, and ensure alignment with the original problem and expected impact
- Re-engage more deeply in initiatives that require additional user discovery or validation during delivery, particularly where solutions depend on nuanced user behavior or feedback
- Collaborate with Product Delivery and Technology leadership to continuously improve handoff quality, planning effectiveness, and overall delivery outcomes
- Provide coaching, mentorship, and career development support to direct reports
- Set clear expectations, provide regular feedback, and foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement
- Support hiring and onboarding efforts to build a high-performing product team

Skills:
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, business administration, information systems, data science, marketing, economics, engineering, or a relevant field required
- 5+ years in product management with progressive responsibility, including ownership of product roadmaps and cross-functional stakeholder management
- Experience in iGaming, online casino, sports betting, or adjacent regulated consumer tech industries
- Demonstrated ability to use data and experimentation to drive product decisions
- Able to travel occasionally both domestically and internationally
- Open to candidates in eligible locations in the Continental US or Canada

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Prescriber Experience
jobs.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to remove the traditional barriers to therapy and make mental health care more accessible to everyone. Founded in 2013, we are now the world's largest online therapy service, providing affordable and convenient therapy across the globe. Our network of over 30,000 licensed therapists has helped millions of people take ownership of their mental health and change their lives forever. And we're not stopping there – as the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.


As a Senior Product Manager at BetterHelp, you'll join a diverse team of licensed clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. And as a mental health company, we take employee mental health just as seriously as we do our mission. We deeply invest in our team's well-being and professional development, because we know that business and individual growth go hand-in-hand. At BetterHelp, you'll carve your own path, make an immediate impact, and be challenged every day – with a supportive community behind you the whole way.

What are we looking for?

BetterHelp is looking for an IC that is excellent at execution and has a passion for building and growing successful consumer (B2C) products. This individual will take start-to-finish responsibility on some of our highest impact projects which can include bringing to market new products and features, as well as optimizing our existing products to improve quality of the platform and accelerate growth. It is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants to work on interesting projects, is highly data fluent, excited about seeing the results/and the impact it can have all while making a difference in the lives of many people globally.

What will you do?

  • Own problem discovery, solution design, and delivery for prescriber onboarding & core experience within BetterHelp's portfolio of companies.
  • Ensure a high standard of care by optimizing the therapist and client experience, focusing on quality & client outcomes.
  • Work cross functionally with other PMs to support marketplace engagement
  • Lead highly visible and critical initiatives that materially impact the trajectory of the company. This includes end to end ownership of new products, features and experiments with a focus on driving product quality
  • Initiate, evaluate and prioritize ideas, gather requirements and create specifications for all product changes that will achieve maximum impact and benefit.
  • Analyze and quantify the impact and success of each and every product change we've made, and then draw conclusions and plan next steps based on actual data.
  • Collaborate with the development and design teams before, during, and after each "sprint" to maximize resources' efficiency, utilization, and happiness.
  • Partner with the design team, create a user experience that is both delightful and effective.
  • Perform UAT and functional QA to make sure we're launching only good stuff!
  • Internally: Work cross-functional with all parts of the company (development, support, marketing, clinical, operations) in order to (a) convert their insights into product improvements; and (b) to convey the performed changes to them and to make sure they are being integrated and used effectively.
  • Externally: Connect with all external stakeholders (members, providers, marketing channels, business partners, regulators) both inbound and outbound to make sure our product is meeting their needs and requirements.
  • Participate in setting the strategy and long-term direction for the organization.
  • Continually seek ways to improve everything we do and optimize the value we bring to our stakeholders.
  • Own KPI's and be obsessed about them.
  • In a nutshell: Ideate, execute, test, measure, analyze, learn, iterate

What will you NOT do?

  • You will NOT worry about "runway", "cash left", or "how much time we have until the next round". We have the startup DNA but we're fully backed and funded, all the way to success.
  • You will NOT be confined to your "job". You will get involved in product, marketing, business strategy, and almost everything we do.
  • You will NOT be bogged down by office politics, ego, or bad attitude. Only positive, pleasure-to-work-with people are allowed here!
  • You will NOT get yourself burned out. We work hard but we believe in maintaining a sustainable work/life balance. Really.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. We operate on PST and candidates in any time zone are welcome to apply. We ask employees to travel to our San Jose, CA office up to three times per year plus one company-wide offsite to collaborate in person and strengthen working relationships. Travel expenses are covered and reasonable accommodations are made for those under unique circumstances who cannot travel.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a product role at a B2C company and proven success through measurable impact and increasing responsibilities.
  • Growth and experiments driven mindset with a proven ability to execute and deliver results.
  • Basic SQL knowledge to navigate and utilize BI tools effectively.
  • Deep understanding of unit/business economics and proven ability to balance business and technical considerations for product decisions.
  • Super analytical: proven experience in using data and relevant tools for driving critical business outcomes.
  • Experience in quickly launching products on a regular basis in an agile environment with a track record of delivering products on time and with high quality.
  • Great eye for UX and understanding of its related metrics.
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills, strong attention to detail, able to work independently.

Bonus:

  • Fundamental coding skills, with experience in building an app.
  • Experience with marketplace-based business models.
  • High level of proficiency with data analysis with SQL, BI tools and product analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with APIs & vendor integrations.
  • Experience in both desktop and mobile environments.

Benefits

  • Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company
  • Competitive compensation
  • Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)
  • Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution
  • The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love
  • Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive
  • An awesome community of co-workers

The base salary range for this position is $170,000-$200,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026. Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.

At BetterHelp we thrive on difference and individuality, and as part of the Teladoc Health family, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status, parental status, disability, or Veteran status.

jobs.title: LAC Acceptance growth center of excellence  – Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
Job Description
Overview:
We are seeking a high-impact Product Manager to support the execution and scaling of the Acceptance Growth Center of Excellence (AG COE) across Latin America and the Caribbean (LAC). This role will operate at the center of one of Visa's most strategic initiatives, driving expansion across two key growth vectors:
Merchant growth and graduation (long-tail / SMB segment)
Expansion into new payment flows, including bill payments and recurring transactions
This person will work closely with the AG COE Product Director to translate strategy into execution, leading pilots, coordinating cross-functional efforts, and scaling solutions across markets. This is a highly dynamic role requiring both hands-on execution and strong strategic thinking, with a focus on rapid experimentation, ecosystem orchestration, and driving measurable impact. The ideal candidate is proactive, analytical, and highly collaborative-able to break down complex problems, build structured approaches, and mobilize teams across functions, organizations, and geographies.
Key Responsibilities:
Execution of AG COE Strategy and Roadmap:
Drive the day-to-day execution of the AG COE roadmap across LAC, ensuring alignment across: Acceptance solutions, Merchant growth and graduation initiatives, Value-added services (credit, insights, operational tools), Bill payment expansion.
Translate strategic priorities into clear execution plans, timelines, and deliverables. Track progress and ensure accountability across multiple stakeholders and functions.
Pilot Development and Experimentation:
Lead the design and execution of MVP pilots across priority markets. Apply a structured test-and-learn approach, including: Hypothesis definition, Experiment design, KPI tracking (conversion, adoption, monetization, retention).
Coordinate with partners (issuers, acquirers, fintechs) to launch pilots quickly. Leverage data and AI tools to accelerate insights, decision-making, and iteration cycles.
Continuously refine initiatives based on performance and feedback.
SMB Growth and Graduation Execution:
Support implementation and optimization of the merchant graduation model (nano → micro → small).
Identify and remove friction across the merchant journey: Onboarding, Activation, Conversion to higher tiers.
Drive adoption of value-added services (VAS) to increase merchant engagement and monetization.
Ensure alignment between product capabilities, pricing, and merchant value proposition.
Bill Payments Expansion:
Support execution of Visa’s strategy to expand into bill payments ecosystems.
Identify and onboard key partners: Billers, Aggregators and platforms. Coordinate pilot implementations of: Card-on-file, Autopay, Presentment integrations.
Work with markets to expand successful use cases across countries and verticals.
Ecosystem Coordination and Partner Integration:
Coordinate onboarding and integration of: 3rd party acquirers and VAS providers (lending, fraud, accounting, etc.).
Support development of playbooks and integration models for partners. Facilitate collaboration across internal (Product, Sales, Data, Pricing) and external stakeholders.
Help ensure that all players (issuers, acquirers, partners) operate cohesively within the platform.
Insights, Analytics, and Performance Management:
Monitor and analyze key performance metrics across pilots and scaled initiatives: Merchant onboarding and activation, Transaction volume and usage, VAS adoption, Customer satisfaction (NPS).
Support the development and activation of the insights layer (VCTS, analytics models).
Translate data into actionable recommendations for: Product improvements, GTM adjustments, Partnership strategies.
Cross-Functional Execution and Influence:
Work closely with Global product and engineering teams, Regional Sales and Market teams, Pricing, Legal, Data, and CMS. Act as a bridge between strategy and execution, ensuring ideas translate into real deployments.
Build alignment and influence decisions across stakeholders without direct authority.
Support leadership communication by preparing structured updates, insights, and recommendations.
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications
Basic Qualifications:
5 or more years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD.
Preferred Qualifications:
6 or more years of work experience with a Bachelors Degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA,  JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD
5–7 years of experience in product management, fintech, payments, or related industries
Proven ability to execute complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders and markets
Strong analytical mindset with experience in:
Experimentation
Data analysis
Performance optimization
Experience working in cross-functional and matrixed environments
Ability to operate independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with ability to influence without direct authority
Experience with APIs, platforms, or technical integrations is a strong plus
Deep interest in: Payments and fintech ecosystems, SMB needs and behavior in emerging markets
Languages: Fluent English and Spanish required; Portuguese is a plus.
Information for US Applicants
For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $133.300,00 to $ 213.400,00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Dashboard
jobs.description:
Vercel is an agentic infrastructure company that helps builders ship and run software with speed, security, and developer experience. The Product Manager will own the Vercel Dashboard vision, strategy, and roadmap, evolving it into a personalized, agent-powered control plane while coordinating consistent experiences across product teams. The role will also focus on performance, experimentation, onboarding, adoption, and engagement analytics.

Responsibilities:
- Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Vercel Dashboard, the primary surface through which all Vercel customers interact with the platform
- Define how agents operate within the Dashboard, from surfacing errors and suggesting fixes to updating code and config on behalf of users
- Shift the Dashboard from a passive "pull" experience to a proactive "push" experience, surfacing insights, notifications, and recommended actions
- Define the information architecture and design patterns that product area teams build within, and partner with those teams (Billing, CI/CD, Observability) to keep their experiences consistent and high-quality within the Dashboard shell
- Collaborate with Engineering to hold an uncompromising performance bar. The Dashboard must be the fastest, most delightful surface at Vercel
- Run experiments and measure onboarding funnel performance, feature adoption, and engagement across user segments

Skills:
- You've built and shipped developer-facing products
- You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, cloud, or developer tools companies
- You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple
- You think about the product from both a human and an agent perspective. You use AI tools in your own workflow and have a point of view on how agents should interact with product surfaces
- You have experience running experiments and working with product analytics to drive roadmap decisions
- Have worked on platform or horizontal product teams where you set patterns that other teams adopt
- Have an engineering background or have built software yourself
- Have worked on onboarding, activation, or growth loops in a product-led growth context
- Have experience with personalization frameworks or systems that adapt to user segments and lifecycle stages

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager
jobs.description:
Superhuman Mail is part of the Superhuman Suite, an AI productivity platform aimed at enhancing user efficiency. The Senior Growth Product Manager will lead the Product-Led Growth strategy, focusing on driving sustainable growth through customer acquisition, retention, and expansion.

Responsibilities:
- Own the end-to-end PLG growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion
- Identify and prioritize the highest-impact growth opportunities based on data, user insights, and market trends
- Drive fast-paced experimentation to optimize conversion funnels and unlock new revenue opportunities
- Partner with engineering, analytics, PMM, and customer-facing teams to build and iterate on high-performing growth loops
- Lead growth pods to execute roadmap initiatives — with clear ownership over experiment planning, execution, and analysis
- Influence go-to-market strategy, pricing & packaging, and product-led sales efforts through customer insights and experimentation
- Define and track key growth metrics, including activation rates, retention cohorts, LTV/CAC, and expansion revenue
- Use data to surface bottlenecks, test hypotheses, and refine the roadmap to maximize business impact
- Build feedback loops between product and go-to-market teams to continually improve user onboarding and engagement

Skills:
- 3+ years of experience in growth product management, ideally in B2B SaaS or a product-led environment
- Proven track record in PLG or self-serve models, with success owning metrics like signup-to-activation, retention, expansion, and LTV/CAC
- Connect market insight → PLG roadmap → OKRs. Prioritize the highest-impact bets across acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion
- Design statistically sound A/B tests, ship fast iterations, learn aloud, and scale wins
- Surface 'gold spots' in messy funnels, define crisp KPIs, and tell the story behind the numbers
- Rally Design, Eng, Data, PMM, and GTM pods. Clarify scope, trade-offs, and timelines
- Earn trust up, down, and sideways. Frame decisions, secure buy-in, and navigate change with empathy and clarity
- Turn insight into shipped value quickly. Align fast, unblock teams, and hit timing windows
- Generate and refine novel growth ideas, test constraints, and find workable alternatives
- Build a deep understanding of customer journeys and pain points. Leverage interviews, usage data, and frontline feedback
- Embrace opportunities, welcome feedback, and believe you and others can always grow
- Believe AI will revolutionize how we work and the experiences we create for our customers
- Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manage tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyze and execute work efficiently, collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrive in fast-paced, results-driven environments

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
At WHOOP, we’re on a mission to unlock human performance and healthspan. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Growth Product team and own critical strategic areas of how we acquire, convert, and retain new members. This is an opportunity to develop and drive the long-term strategy for a core pillar of growth, working backward from an end-state vision to deliver compounding impact on company-level metrics. You’ll operate as a fully self-sufficient strategic leader who translates vague concepts into customer value, raises the bar for product craft across the team, and partners closely with executive stakeholders in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Develop and maintain the long-term product strategy for several areas at once that span the Growth funnel (acquisition, conversion, activation, or retention), setting measurable goals tied directly to company growth targets across web and app experiences.Own KPIs over the long term — set the strategic direction, exhibit mastery of priorities and roadmap decisions, and consistently hit customer and business goals quarter over quarter.Lead end-to-end product discovery, delivery, and iteration — contributing across research, ideation, requirements, prototyping, and testing — and partner deeply with Engineering, Design, and Analytics to ship high-impact solutions on accelerated timelines.Design and run a rigorous experimentation program: form explicit hypotheses, validate assumptions, structure A/B tests, and translate learnings into a compounding roadmap of wins.Write crisp product strategy documents and product specs and operate as the directly responsible individual for execution quality from discovery through launch and post-launch iteration.Act as the strategic voice for the customer — speak to member needs, pain points, and behavior better than anyone else in the company, and translate that depth into product decisions and cross-functional alignment.Anticipate complexity and proactively de-risk long-term initiatives through smart scoping, phasing, and technical foresight in partnership with Engineering.Partner with Marketing, Operations, Finance, and executive leadership to influence company-level growth strategy and align cross-functional initiatives around your roadmap.Mentor PMs and analysts across the Growth org, raise the bar for product craft, and contribute to the team’s operating cadence, best practices, and hiring.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

5–8+ years of product management experience (or equivalent in growth/related roles) with a track record of multiple shipped products that produced measurable, long-term business impact.Demonstrated ability to develop coherent product strategy from ambiguous problem spaces and then translating strategy into phased, executable roadmaps.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; highly proficient in SQL and product analytics tools (Amplitude, Sigma, or equivalent) and able to independently pull, model, and interpret data without analyst support.Direct experience with DTC subscription products, digital consumer growth funnels, and best-in-class onboarding and gamification mechanics including running structured experimentation programs at scale.Deep customer empathy and product intuition paired with a rigorous, data-informed mindset; able to read between the lines of customer feedback and form/validate hypotheses explicitly.Excellent written and verbal communication; proven ability to influence executive stakeholders, drive alignment across senior cross-functional partners, and articulate trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.Completely self-sufficient and known for being highly dependable; comfortable defining problems, structuring approaches, and driving clarity in fast-moving, loosely-defined spaces.Track record of mentoring more junior PMs and raising the craft bar of the teams around you.Highly organized, adaptable, and energized by a fast-paced, collaborative environment.Passionate about fitness, wellness, and WHOOP’s mission.Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day-to-day tasks, ensuring AI-assisted work aligns with the same high-quality standards as personal contributions.

This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. The successful candidate must be prepared to relocate if necessary to work out of the Boston, MA office. 

Interested in the role, but don’t meet every qualification? We encourage you to still apply! At WHOOP, we believe there is much more to a candidate than what is written on paper, and we value character as much as experience. As we continue to build a diverse and inclusive environment, we encourage anyone who is interested in this role to apply.

WHOOP is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-verify to determine employment eligibility. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

The WHOOP compensation philosophy is designed to attract, motivate, and retain exceptional talent by offering competitive base salaries, meaningful equity, and consistent pay practices that reflect our mission and core values.

At WHOOP, we view total compensation as the combination of base salary, equity, and benefits, with equity serving as a key differentiator that aligns our employees with the long-term success of the company and allows every member of our corporate team to own part of WHOOP and share in the company’s long-term growth and success.

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $155,000 - $215,000. Salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within each range, individual pay is based on factors such as job-related skills, experience, performance, and relevant education or training. 

In addition to the base salary, the successful candidate will also receive benefits and a generous equity package.

These ranges may be modified in the future to reflect evolving market conditions and organizational needs. While most offers will typically fall toward the starting point of the range, total compensation will depend on the candidate’s specific qualifications, expertise, and alignment with the role’s requirements.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Growth
jobs.description:
About Glean:
Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.
At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.
Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.
If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more - deeply embedded where people get things done. You’ll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.
About the Role:
Glean is seeking a highly strategic and execution-oriented Product Manager to help define and build our Growth product area. This role sits at the intersection of product-led growth (PLG), platform-level activation, off-surface engagement, and broader product growth strategy.
You will own how Glean turns first-touch curiosity into durable, expanding usage — designing the loops, surfaces, and experiences that drive activation, retention, and organic expansion across users and teams. Glean's company strategy emphasizes becoming the trusted enterprise context and intelligence layer that every employee reaches for daily; getting there depends on a world-class growth motion that brings users in, gets them to value fast, and keeps them coming back across every surface they work in.
You will work closely with the Product lead and cross-functional partners across engineering, design, data, marketing, and go-to-market teams to identify the highest-leverage growth bets, bring structure to an ambiguous opportunity space, and translate growth concepts into concrete, measurable product experiences. We're currently a very lean product team, so you'll have an outsized role in shaping both the product roadmap and the product team itself.
This role is ideal for someone with 5+ years of experience, a deep understanding of PLG and growth mechanics, a passion for AI, and the ability to demonstrate granular product implementation skills such as designing specific user interfaces, onboarding flows, and experiments rather than staying at a high conceptual level.
You will:
Help define and drive the product strategy and roadmap for Growth, translating broad company vision into specific bets across activation, retention, and expansion, informed by funnel data, experimentation, and customer behavior.
Own the PLG motion end to end — from acquisition and onboarding through activation, habit formation, and self-serve expansion — and design the loops that turn individual adopters into team- and org-wide usage.
Build platform-level growth capabilities such as referrals, invitations, notifications, in-product education, and lifecycle messaging that compound across surfaces rather than living in a single feature.
Drive off-surface growth by meeting users where they already work — the browser extension, email, Slack and Teams, mobile, and other entry points — so Glean stays present and valuable outside of a single destination app.
Partner deeply with engineering, design, and data teams to turn ambiguous concepts into well-scoped products and experiments, with clear user flows, interaction patterns, instrumentation, quality standards, and measurable outcomes.
Build a rigorous experimentation and measurement culture, defining the activation and retention metrics that matter, instrumenting the funnel, and running A/B tests to learn fast and ship what moves the numbers.
Drive customer-focused prioritization and efficient execution, balancing long-term platform opportunities with urgent user pain points, strategic customer asks, and company priorities.
Collaborate closely with go-to-market, marketing, solutions, and support teams to learn from real customer problems and ensure our growth strategy reflects how users actually adopt and spread Glean.
Bring a high bar for product craft by not only identifying the right opportunities, but also specifying how they should work in practice, including concrete onboarding flows, UI behavior, and adoption paths.
About you:
You have 5+ years of experience in product management, with a track record of owning and shipping growth, activation, or PLG product areas in B2B SaaS, consumer, AI, or platform products.
You are deeply fluent in growth mechanics — funnels, activation, retention, virality, and lifecycle — and you let data and experimentation guide your decisions, with the analytical fluency to define metrics, instrument funnels, and interpret results alongside engineering and data teams.
You have strong product sense and granular product thinking, comfortable moving between strategy and detailed execution and specifying how a user should experience onboarding and adoption.
You have a deep interest in AI and enterprise software, and you thrive in ambiguous spaces, creating clarity, momentum, and alignment even when the product area is still emerging.
You are an excellent communicator, take ownership and initiative, collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners, and bring a learning and growth mindset.
You are mission-first, measure your success by your product and team's success, and are an early adopter of AI for your own craft who's excited to help customers accelerate their AI adoption journey.
Location:
This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our San Francisco office)
Compensation & Benefits:
The standard base salary range for this position is $175,000 - $280,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.
We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.
#LI-HYBRID
AI-First Mindset at Glean:
At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work.
As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.
Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
tastytrade is a fintech company focused on democratizing trading and empowering individual investors. They are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the futures trading experience, leading strategy and execution while driving measurable business outcomes and navigating complexity across markets and stakeholders.

Responsibilities:
- Lead strategy and execution for the full futures product surface, including the active trader interface, ‘pairs’ trader, DOM and ladder, chart-integrated order entry, calendar spread and roll workflows, and options-on-futures entry
- Ensure a fast, precise, and trustworthy experience for active traders across web, mobile, and desktop, while recognizing that each platform has unique constraints and highest-value use cases
- Develop a comprehensive product strategy for futures that translates business vision into executable plans
- Define and track OKRs and KPIs tied to futures trading volume, active trader retention, and micro contract adoption
- Build business cases for new product investments with clear ROI projections and competitive positioning
- Own the product decisions that sit at the intersection of trading infrastructure, exchange relationships, and regulatory requirements, including margin methodology (SPAN), overnight vs. intraday requirement communication, clearing and reconciliation, and session transition UX
- As tastytrade expands its role in futures market infrastructure, you’ll help define what new capabilities mean for the customer experience, working closely with legal, compliance, and operations to translate regulatory milestones into product opportunities
- You’ll communicate confidently with executive stakeholders while translating between technical and business perspectives, and manage cross-functional dependencies with the options, equities, and core platform teams
- Partner with marketing and content teams to identify opportunities to bring new traders into futures, particularly through the micro contract product lineup (/MES, /MNQ, /MBT, and others), and design the onboarding, education, and activation flows that get them to their first successful trade

Skills:
- 5+ years of product management experience with demonstrated success leading complex product initiatives, managing stakeholder relationships, and delivering products that drove significant business outcomes and revenue growth
- Deep familiarity with futures markets: understanding contract specifications, tick sizes, margin mechanics (SPAN), expiration and roll dynamics, and the difference between equity index, commodity, interest rate, and crypto futures products
- Expertise in high-performance trading interfaces, with a strong point of view on what active futures traders need from order entry, position management, and risk display across web, mobile, and desktop
- Strong technical and commercial acumen: ability to define comprehensive non-functional requirements around latency, data fidelity, and session handling, and work in lockstep with engineering while building business cases and tracking financial metrics tied to product performance
- Mastery of advanced PM methods: expert with prototyping, A/B testing, advanced analytics, and roadmapping platforms, with experience leveraging AI and machine learning to optimize product capabilities
- Exceptional communication and leadership skills: able to tailor messaging to diverse stakeholders from engineers to executives, with experience mentoring junior product managers and establishing scalable ways of working across teams
- Passion for empowering individual traders and improving the futures trading experience through data-driven insights and strategic decision-making
- Experience in fintech, retail brokerage, or an adjacent regulated industry is strongly preferred
- Direct experience building or using futures trading platforms is a significant advantage
- Familiarity with futures market structure, including clearing, execution, and the role of FCMs in the trade lifecycle, will be particularly valuable

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer Payments
jobs.description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Consumer Payments to lead Toast’s consumer payments strategy and product area. This role will shape how diners pay across the Toast ecosystem, while also helping restaurants benefit from more seamless experiences, stronger guest loyalty, and improved economics.

In this role, you will define and drive the strategy, roadmap, and execution for consumer payment experiences at Toast. This includes card and stored value experiences, guest checkout innovation, loyalty- and rewards-linked payments, and emerging payment methods that improve both the guest experience and cost of acceptance.

You will work cross-functionally with teams across Consumer, Payments, Engineering, Design, Data, Risk, Operations, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, and Go-to-Market to turn an ambitious vision into a scalable and differentiated product portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of consumer experience, payments innovation, and business strategy, and requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, leadership, and comfort operating in ambiguity.

A Day In The Life (Responsibilities)

Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Consumer Payments, aligning near-term execution with Toast’s long-term strategy. Define the end-to-end consumer payment experience across areas such as wallet, stored value, guest checkout, rewards-linked payments, and emerging lower-cost payment methods. Partner with Consumer and Guest teams to create payment experiences that are seamless, intuitive, and habit-forming for diners across Toast surfaces. Work closely with other Payment teams, Risk, Finance, Legal, and Operations teams to design solutions that are compliant, scalable, and economically compelling. Drive product discovery and prioritization grounded in customer needs, business impact, technical feasibility, and strategic differentiation. Lead complex cross-functional initiatives involving internal platform teams and external partners. Translate broad strategic goals into clear milestones, measurable outcomes, and focused execution plans. Use data to evaluate adoption, engagement, conversion, retention, payment mix, margin impact, and customer value. Communicate strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, progress, and risks clearly to senior leadership and stakeholders across Toast. Embrace and advocate for the use of AI tools to accelerate product discovery, streamline execution, and explore new product experiences - helping shape how we build and what we build. 

Do you have the right ingredients?* (Requirements)

8+ years of product management experience, including significant experience in payments, fintech, consumer payments, wallets, or other complex platform businesses. Track record of defining, building, and scaling products in ambiguous, cross-functional environments. Strong understanding of digital payments, wallets, stored value, alternative payment methods, or consumer fintech ecosystems. Ability to balance customer experience, technical complexity, risk and compliance constraints, and business economics. Strong technical fluency and comfort partnering deeply with engineering on architecture, APIs, dependencies, and rollout planning. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and align cross-functional teams. Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to move fluidly between detail and big-picture strategy. Experience with marketplace, network, loyalty, or two-sided platform models is a plus. 

Special Sauce* (Nice to Have)

Experience building wallet, stored value, prepaid, debit, or rewards-linked payment products. Familiarity with merchant economics, cost-of-acceptance levers, or alternative payment rails such as ACH or pay by bank. Experience in hospitality, commerce, or local marketplace products. 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is Baked into our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry is one of the most diverse, and we embrace that diversity with authenticity, inclusivity, respect, and humility. jobs.title: Product Manager - Fix Experience
jobs.description:
About Stitch Fix, Inc.

Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) is the leading online personal styling service that helps people discover the styles they will love that fit perfectly so they always look - and feel - their best. Few things are more personal than getting dressed, but finding clothing that fits and looks great can be a challenge. Stitch Fix solves that problem. By pairing expert stylists with best-in-class AI and recommendation algorithms, the company leverages its assortment of exclusive and national brands to meet each client's individual tastes and needs, making it convenient for clients to express their personal style without having to spend hours in stores or sifting through endless choices online. Stitch Fix, which was founded in 2011, is headquartered in San Francisco.

About the Role

Stitch Fix is at the forefront of e-commerce, personalization, and AI. As a Product Manager for our core Fix Experience—our largest business unit—you will shape the future of how clients discover and evolve their personal style. We are looking for a dynamic product leader who operates with high urgency and velocity, capable of turning complex problems into highly personalized, engaging client experiences that drive retention.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Drive Massive Business Impact: Take on a tremendous responsibility for our largest and most critical business unit. The innovation, features, and improvements you launch here will have a direct, significant impact on Stitch Fix's overall company performance. Delivering measurable results at this scale is key.
  • Define the Vision & Strategy: Create a compelling strategic narrative, product strategy, and release plan spanning both immediate quarterly goals and a 1-3 year time horizon.
  • Drive Execution with Velocity: Move with high urgency to champion innovative product ideas, taking them from zero to one through deep discovery, customer interviews, prototyping, and rapid iteration. You will adeptly balance investments across breakthrough innovation, core feature improvements, and foundational technical excellence.
  • Manage a Dynamic Portfolio: Balance and deliver on a large, complex portfolio of multiple workstreams, products, and simultaneous feature launches.
  • Lead Cross-Functional Alignment: Foster tight collaboration across Design, Algorithms, Engineering, Merchandising, Marketing, and Operational teams to build solutions that exceed client expectations and drive business growth.
  • Elevate the Product Culture: Work collaboratively across the broader group of Product Managers to foster and act as a role model for a high-performance, inclusive culture. You will actively coach and mentor peers, consistently identifying opportunities to uplevel the product discipline and practices across the organization.

We’re excited about you because you have…

  • Experience: 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in direct-to-consumer (DTC), retail, or e-commerce. You bring a strong track record of building and scaling subscription-based products, leveraging recommendation systems and personalization to drive customer engagement and retention. Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business discipline (MBA is a plus).
  • Masterful Prioritization: You excel at ruthless prioritization, driven by a deep understanding of the client and our business model. You are adept at estimating impact—knowing exactly what is worth building and when to build it—while managing complex teams, interconnected systems, and competing stakeholder objectives to maximize team impact.
  • Strategic & Analytical Rigor: You easily extract actionable insights from competing data sources, defining A/B experiments and leveraging statistical data to guide go-forward opportunities. Well-versed in Agile methodologies.
  • Thoughtful Collaboration: You build strong relationships, empower diverse perspectives, and effectively communicate business cases and roadmaps to cross-functional partners and executive leadership.
  • Product Sense: You have a keen eye for UX, working closely with Product Design to craft intuitive, delightful, and customer-centric experiences.

Why you'll love working at Stitch Fix...

  • We are a group of bright, kind people who are motivated by challenge. We value integrity, innovation and trust. You’ll bring these characteristics to life in everything you do at Stitch Fix.
  • We cultivate a community of diverse perspectives— all voices are heard and valued.
  • We are an innovative company and leverage our strengths in fashion and tech to disrupt the future of retail.
  • We win as a team, commit to our work, and celebrate grit together because we value strong relationships.
  • We boldly create the future while keeping equity and sustainability at the center of all that we do.
  • We are the owners of our work and are energized by solving problems through a growth mindset lens. We think broadly and creatively through every situation to create meaningful impact.
  • We offer comprehensive compensation packages and inclusive health and wellness benefits.

Compensation and Benefits

This role will receive a competitive salary, benefits, and equity. The salary for US-based employees hired into this role will be aligned with the range below, which includes our three geographic areas. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, location, and performance. jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team 

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own the vision, strategy, and execution for our In Store Tasks product. This role sits at the intersection of shopper experience, retailer and CPG enablement and plays a big role in improving the reliability of fulfillment for our customers.

Fulfillment quality is a critical driver of customer satisfaction and retailer trust at Instacart. jobs.description:
About Us:
Live experiences help people cross today's digital divide and focus on what truly connects us – the here, the now, this once-in-a-lifetime moment that's bringing us together. To fulfill Gametime's mission of uniting the world through shared experiences, we make it easy for people to discover and access the live experiences that matter most.
With platforms on iOS, Android, mobile web and desktop supporting more than 60,000 events across the US and Canada, we are reimagining the event ticket industry in order to move at the speed of life.

The Role

Gametime's Payments & Checkout team owns everything that happens between ticket selection and a completed transaction — checkout flow, payment methods, vendor relationships, and the infrastructure behind every dollar we process. This PM will own the roadmap for growing conversion and authorization performance while managing fraud exposure and the economics of how we accept payments, partnering closely with our BNPL, processing, and wallet vendors to expand what we offer fans and merchants alike.

This role is open to various levels/ titles — Senior Product Manager, Staff Product Manager, or Principal Product Manager — we're hiring for the right person and scope, not a fixed level.

What You'll Own

  • Checkout conversion: identify and eliminate friction across the payment flow, and run experimentation to lift completion rates
  • Payment authorization rates: partner with processors and networks to reduce declines and recover failed transactions
  • BNPL adoption: grow usage and expand the mix of buy-now-pay-later and alternative payment methods offered at checkout
  • Fraud and risk trade-offs: balance conversion growth against fraud exposure, working with risk tooling and rules to protect margin without adding friction
  • Vendor strategy: manage and evaluate payment processors, BNPL providers, and wallet partners to improve terms, performance, and total cost of acceptance
  • Cost of payments: drive down the blended cost of accepting transactions as volume and AOV grow
  • A roadmap tied directly to transaction growth, AOV, and payments cost efficiency

What We're Looking For

Common bar:

  • A track record of shipping product changes that moved measurable business outcomes
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills — you'll work closely with engineering, design, and data day-to-day
  • Comfort operating at whatever level you're hired into, from hands-on execution to setting multi-quarter strategy

Domain-specific:

  • Experience owning payments, checkout, or fraud/risk in a consumer marketplace, fintech, or high-volume e-commerce environment
  • Familiarity with the mechanics of authorization, processing, and payment routing, and how they connect to conversion and cost
  • Experience managing vendor and processor relationships, including negotiating terms and evaluating new partners
  • A data-driven approach — comfort working with SQL/analytics to diagnose funnel and payment performance issues

Coinbase

This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. As a Product Manager II on the Growth team within the
Consumer & Business
group, you'll own the end-to-end notifications platform spanning push, in-app, and email channels. This team drives user engagement and retention by delivering the right message to the right user at the right time. You'll define the strategy for how Coinbase communicates with millions of customers, leveraging ML-powered relevance to increase activation, re-engagement, and lifetime value.
What you'll do:
Own the product roadmap for Coinbase's notifications platform across push, in-app, and email channels, balancing infrastructure investment with growth experimentation.
Drive measurable improvements in user engagement, activation, and retention through personalized, ML-powered notification strategies.
Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing to build relevance models that improve targeting precision and reduce notification fatigue.
Lead experimentation programs (A/B and multivariate testing) to validate notification timing, content, and channel selection at scale.
Shape the long-term platform architecture to support new channels, audience segmentation, and real-time personalization capabilities.
Required Skills and Experience:
5+ years of product management experience with at least 2 years focused on growth, engagement, or lifecycle products at scale (1M+ users).
Proven track record shipping ML-powered personalization or relevance features, with demonstrated ability to partner with data science teams on model development and evaluation.
Deep expertise in experimentation methodology, including designing A/B tests, defining success metrics, and interpreting results to inform roadmap decisions.
Experience owning a multi-channel messaging or notifications platform (push, in-app, email), including deliverability, opt-in optimization, and frequency management.
Fluency in SQL and data analysis tools, with a demonstrated habit of self-serving insights to drive product decisions without waiting for analyst support.
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Fitness Technologies Product Manager
jobs.description:
Imagine what you could do at Apple.

Join the Fitness Technologies and Experiences team and enable impactful change on a global scale.

We are looking for an exceptional Product Manager to help shape the next generation of fitness and wellness experiences across Apple's hardware, software, and services ecosystem. This is a rare opportunity to make a meaningful, global impact — helping millions of people live a healthier, more active life every single day.


In this role, you will own the product vision and strategy for Apple's fitness ecosystem, spanning the Fitness, Activity, Workout, and Health apps, as well as the Fitness+ service. You will bring deep consumer insight and industry expertise to define the future of digital health and wellness — then make it real. Working hand-in-hand with Design, Engineering, Fitness, and Health leadership, you will innovate, and then create, cohesive, high-impact product experiences. This role demands strong product perspective, deep understanding of user needs, exceptional cross-functional leadership, the ability to drive strategic alignment across a large organization, and the executive presence to communicate it all with clarity and confidence.

The ideal candidate brings deep roots in consumer-facing fitness, professional sports, and/or athletic training — and will serve as an authoritative voice on how Apple can help users at every level live healthier lives through genuinely engaging fitness experiences.

You will own and drive the feature roadmap across Apple's Health and Fitness ecosystem, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Fitness Content and Expertise, Production, Post-Production and Media Technologies, Apple Services Engineering, Product Marketing, Business, Operations, and PR. You'll translate nuanced fitness expertise into direction that is clear and actionable for highly technical and non-technical partners alike. You will also champion Apple's fitness features and experiences externally — with press, partners, and users.


10+ years of deep professional experience in consumer-facing fitness, sports, or athletic training, with the credibility and vocabulary to earn the trust of experts in the field.
Proven track record building fitness and health products that integrate hardware and software seamlessly.
Exceptional ownership and accountability — you drive work streams autonomously, anticipate roadblocks, and maintain transparent, ongoing visibility for leadership and cross-functional partners.
Ability to collaborate with clinical experts, medical professionals, and exercise scientists to ensure that fitness features are medically accurate, evidence-based, and trustworthy.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex, high-stakes projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment — delivering quality results on time, every time.
Strategic vision and storytelling — you can help define the long-term product direction and articulate it compellingly to diverse audiences using competitive analysis, user research, and data analytics.
Ability to be onsite; this role is a hybrid, in-person position.

Working knowledge of behavioral science, habit formation, and motivational psychology — with experience designing sticky experiences that drive long-term engagement and meaningful health outcomes.
Demonstrated commitment to inclusion in product design — a track record of building fitness experiences that authentically serve a diverse range of physical abilities, ages, and fitness levels.
Hands-on experience writing requirements against sensor data, metric algorithms, and hardware/software specifications.
A "whatever it takes" mindset — you proactively step beyond your defined scope, contribute wherever needed, and never let important work fall through the cracks.
A natural collaborator who thrives in team settings, invests in relationships across functions, and brings out the best in the people around them.
Relentless attention to detail and an uncompromising commitment to quality and integrity in everything you ship.
Passionate about building inclusive, positive team culture and embedding diversity best practices into your everyday work.

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards.  Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day.  We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
Job Summary:
Job Description:
PayPal, Inc. seeks Sr Product Manager in San Jose, CA
Job Duties: Define product strategy, roadmap, and prioritization for P2P payments, leveraging data-driven insights and AI/ML to enhance user experiences. Collaborate with engineering, design, and other product managers and stakeholders to execute a product roadmap around PayPal’s global P2P (Peer-to-Peer) opportunities. Partner with Legal, Privacy, and Compliance teams to ensure regulatory adherence without compromising user experience. Balance technical feasibility, AI-driven optimizations, and thoughtful design choices while ensuring fast time-to-market. Articulate product plans, benefits, and results to all stakeholders, including PayPal senior leadership. Design and execute A/B tests to iterate product flows, measure impact, and optimize conversion rates, engagement, and retention. Act as the product owner for the domain, balancing customer needs, business requirements, legal/compliance, growth, and monetization considerations. Gather user research and customer feedback to synthesize feedback and market trends, ensuring product decisions align with real user needs. Work closely with design, engineering, data science, and research teams to build and optimize intuitive experiences across PayPal’s P2P web and mobile platforms.  Partial telecommuting permitted from within a commutable distance.
Minimum Requirements: Master’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Business Administration, Business Management, Product Management, or a closely related field, plus six years of experience in the job offered or a related occupation.

6.           Experience executing international or multi-market product launches, including localization requirements, regulatory/compliance readiness, and rollout planning (3 years);
7.           Experience designing and executing experimentation (A/B testing), including hypothesis definition, success metrics, test design, and results interpretation (3 years);
8.           Experience designing, building, and optimizing consumer web and mobile flows (2 years);
9.           Experience evaluating and integrating AI/ML-enabled capabilities into customer or operational workflows (2 years).
