jobs.title: Product Manager, Support
jobs.description:
Meta Product Managers work with cross-functional teams of engineers, designers, data scientists and researchers to build products. We are looking for Product Managers who value moving quickly and lead AI-native product development at scale.

Be responsible for leading and driving a complex product area; defining success, prioritizing problems and identifying the best strategies, considering wider organizational and company context. Adapt and adjust your strategies to reflect learnings and changes in context. Identify and drive consensus for how to prioritize and realize the most significant opportunities in your product area. Identify when to stop as well as when to start investment. Critically evaluate when AI is (and isn't) the optimal solution, with sophisticated articulation of tradeoffs, risks, and second-order effects. Translate AI capabilities into compelling product visions that create differentiated value. Develop and champion AI-native strategies including comprehensive evals and data strategies that enable continuous improvement. Work with a cross-functional team to define a product vision, develop a roadmap and drive progress against goals and milestones and resolve challenges and blockers, whilst improving team health and up-levelling the effectiveness of the team. Actively identify opportunities and resolve dependencies by creating shared strategies across teams in adjacent product areas. Reimagine workflows, responsibly using AI tools to dramatically increase team velocity and capability. Foster a culture of rapid experimentation and learning across the organization. Scale AI best practices (including responsible AI use), workflows, and artifacts across product teams so the org's capability compounds over time. Support the growth of other PMs and cross-functional team members by providing mentorship and coaching on AI-native practices. Influence strategy and progress across partner functions, enhancing collaboration and resolving divergent goals. Orchestrate complex execution across multiple workstreams by combining AI automation with strategic human oversight—using AI to reduce toil while maintaining high quality and accountability. Communicate product strategy and progress with radical clarity to all stakeholders. Use AI-enabled tools to build products—independently creating tangible artifacts to prototype, validate, or ship. Interpret research and state-of-the-art learnings to design product strategy and apply rigorous logical reasoning. Demonstrate deep understanding of system\/architecture trade-offs and how they impact user experience and business outcomes; lead credible technical discussions with engineering partners. Gather and analyze user research and market analysis to inform product decisions and influence the wider product organization. Design sophisticated experiments and interpret results (leveraging AI to accelerate analysis) and drive concrete product decisions. Define and run evaluations (evals) to interpret model outputs and adjust execution based on learnings—establishing evaluation as a first-class product practice across teams.

8+ years of relevant industry experience with at least 3 years in Product Management Bachelor's degree (or relevant degree equivalent): STEM subject ideal but not essential (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences) Experience in a consumer focused technology company Experience leading cross-functional product team(s) across a full product line: Crafting product mission and strategy, defining product requirements, coordinating resources from other groups (marketing, legal, etc.), and driving the team to achieve key milestones and goals Experience managing a product through the full product lifecycle Proven experience to drive a step change in the performance of a product and the effectiveness of the team that delivers that product Extensive understanding in analyzing large scale, complex data sets and making effective decisions based on data Demonstrated proficiency using AI-enabled tools to build product artifacts Experience developing and scaling AI-native strategies including evals and data strategies across teams Experience integrating a diverse set of requirements from a broad set of users as well as context into a single coherent product strategy Experience leading and motivating teams and influencing across an organisation Demonstrated experience in communication, bringing extreme clarity to complex and technical messages across all audience levels Experience identifying and hiring the right talent to build an AI-capable cross-functional team Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize\/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt\/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

jobs.title: Sr Product Manager - Payments
jobs.description:
LTK's mission is to empower the world's premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success. We have a huge opportunity ahead of us and we're looking for team members who want to create, innovate and disrupt an industry.

We empower our team members to drive innovation, create value, and continue to spearhead the creation of this industry — a game changer when it comes to career growth.

Position Title: Sr Product Manager

Location: US-Remote

About the role

LTK is seeking a strategic, data-driven, and highly customer-centric Senior Product Manager to lead high-impact product initiatives across our creator, shopper, and brand ecosystem. This role sits at the intersection of creator growth, consumer engagement, and brand monetization, helping shape experiences that deepen engagement, unlock monetization opportunities, and drive measurable business outcomes across the platform.

We are looking for product talent that can flex across both brand and creator experiences while balancing customer needs, business priorities, and technical execution. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, operates with urgency and ownership, and can move fluidly between strategy and execution.

As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the full product lifecycle from discovery and strategy through launch, iteration, and optimization. You will partner closely with engineering, design, data science, marketing, sales, operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to define product direction, prioritize roadmap investments, and deliver exceptional customer experiences at scale.

As the creator economy continues to evolve, this role will help shape how creators, brands, and shoppers connect, engage, and monetize through LTK's platform.

How you will make an impact

  • Translate company and product strategy into clear roadmap priorities that drive measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • Own end-to-end product execution, including opportunity sizing, prioritization, experimentation, launch planning, iteration, and post-launch optimization.
  • Drive initiatives that improve creator growth, engagement, monetization, and overall platform performance.
  • Develop a deep understanding of creator, shopper, and brand partner needs through research, customer feedback, analytics, experimentation, and market trends.
  • Use data and AI-enabled workflows to identify opportunities, synthesize insights, evaluate product performance, and inform roadmap decisions.
  • Partner closely with engineering and design to deliver intuitive, scalable, and high-quality product experiences.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across stakeholders, proactively surfacing trade-offs, risks, and dependencies.
  • Identify and prioritize the highest-impact problems to solve, balancing short-term wins with long-term platform strategy.
  • Apply strong product judgment while leveraging AI tools responsibly to accelerate discovery, analysis, documentation, and decision-making.
  • Ensure product quality by thinking holistically about the customer journey across platforms, use cases, and edge cases.
  • Contribute to a strong product culture by raising the bar on strategy, execution, communication, customer empathy, and operational excellence.

What you will bring to LTK

  • 6+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping impactful customer-facing products.
  • Demonstrated ability to define product strategy, build roadmaps, and execute cross-functional initiatives from concept to launch.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience using product, analytics, experimentation, and AI-enabled tools to drive decision-making.
  • Proven ability to use customer insights, experimentation, and performance data to inform product direction and prioritization.
  • Ability to prioritize aggressively and make high-quality decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate product rationale, priorities, and trade-offs to diverse audiences.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing across engineering, design, data, and business teams.
  • High level of ownership, sound judgment, and comfort operating in fast-paced, evolving environments with changing priorities.
  • Strong product sense and customer empathy, with a passion for building intuitive and effective experiences.
  • Growth mindset and willingness to operate strategically while also diving into tactical execution details when needed.
  • A mindset focused on seizing opportunities and moving with urgency
  • Dedication to fierce prioritization and operational excellence
  • Adaptability to a dynamic, fast-moving environment
  • A growth mindset and openness to feedback

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in marketplaces, e-commerce, creator platforms, ad-tech, mar-tech, or consumer products.
  • Familiarity with creator, brand, engagement, monetization, or personalization product experiences.
  • Experience with experimentation, KPI-driven product development, or AI-enabled product workflows.
  • Understanding of the creator economy, social platforms, and multi-sided ecosystems. #LI-AJ1

What we offer

  • The opportunity to be part of the leading global company in creator commerce
  • A remote-first, productivity-first environment
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package to meet the needs of you and your family
  • 401(k) with LTK company matching
  • Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance, Dental Insurance
  • Paid Maternity Leave and Paid Paternity Leave
  • Summer Fridays and Flexible PTO

About LTK

Founded in 2011, LTK is the global technology platform purpose-built to empower lifestyle creators to monetize their content. The full-service platform connects brands, creators, and shoppers with a world-class shopping app and trusted tools and technology that make content instantly shoppable. Today, premium lifestyle creators in 160+ countries drive more than $5 billion+ in annual retail sales through their LTK Shop profiles. More than 40 million consumers turn to LTK Shops in the LTK shopping platform each month to find inspiration and instantly shop the styles recommended by their favorite creators. More than 8,000 retailers and 1M brands partner with LTK to gain access to its global creator network for content that converts against performance-driven, cross-channel KPIs. LTK is headquartered in Dallas, TX, and currently operates on five continents.

Our mission

To empower the world's premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success.

Our values

  • Here to win
  • Commit to the journey
  • Work well

Commitment to diversity

LTK believes diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental obligations that strengthen our team. We employ a diverse, multi-disciplinary team to build a meaningful company and culture.

For US-Based Roles: We are not offering new sponsorships opportunities at this time for persons requiring employment visas, such as an H-1B; authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.

Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of LTK are considered the property of LTK and are not subject to payment of agency fees.

LTK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. #LI-Remote

At Duolingo, you’ll join a team that cares about educating our users, experimenting with big ideas, making fact-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You’ll have limitless learning opportunities and daily collaborations with world-class minds — while doing work that’s both meaningful and fun.

Join our life-changing mission to develop education for our half a billion (and growing!) learners around the world.

Read our blog to learn more.

With our learning app, we have developed a successful business by making learning fun. As our reach grows, we aim to teach even better and set the standard for language proficiency with the Duolingo Score. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the Duolingo Score team, define the vision, and drive product development to establish a globally recognized scoring system. If you are interested in this position, please apply on Twitch's Career site https://www.twitch.tv/jobs/en/
About Us:
Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.
We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X,  and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.
About the Role
Twitch's Commerce organization drives over $1B+ in annual payouts to creators through innovative monetization products. As we continue to evolve how streamers earn and how communities engage, we're looking for a visionary Sr. Product Manager to own the roadmap for supporting streamers through interactive, fun, and mobile-native commerce products.
In this role, you will define and execute the strategy for helping streamers build deeper connections with their communities through interactive features and engaging monetization tools. You'll build solutions for products that help creators monetize (like Bits, Subscriptions, etc) while exploring new ways to help creators earn, engage their audiences, and grow their channels. By focusing on streamer success and community connection, you'll help shape how millions of viewers support their favorite streamers across all devices.
You can work in San Francisco, CA; or Seattle, WA.
You Will
- Lead the product vision and roadmap for high impact Twitch commerce capabilities, balancing near-term customer and business outcomes with longer-term product investments
- Own the one-to-two year vision & drive prioritization for features that help streamers connect and monetize with viewers, including future innovations in community engagement and creator monetization
- Own core streamer success metrics including interaction rates, creator earnings, viewer engagement, mobile conversion, and retention.
- Continuously run experiments to test new features and improve outcomes for streamers and their communities
- Drive multi-screen product strategy, ensuring streamers can engage and monetize their communities seamlessly across devices
- Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Research, and Community teams to deliver products that help streamers succeed and grow their channels
- Champion streamer-first thinking, ensuring all products enhance creator earnings, deepen community bonds, and support channel growth
Perks
- Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
- 401(k)
- Maternity & Parental Leave
- Flexible PTO
- Amazon Employee Discount
Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- 5+ years of work experience as a Product Manager
- Experience with live streaming, gaming, or the broader creator economy
- Experience with monetization products and understanding how to balance creator earnings with a consumer experience
- Experience building consumer-facing products at scale, particularly mobile applications or creator/community tools
- Deep understanding of creator ecosystems: their needs, community dynamics, and what helps them succeed on digital platforms
- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups
- Experience defining 1-2 year product strategies and executing against ambitious roadmaps
Preferred Qualifications
- Familiarity with virtual goods, digital currencies, or in-app purchase systems
- Analytically self-serve: able to write basic SQL, use experimentation/analytics tools and AI tools for product analysis
- Background in social features, chat systems, or real-time interactive experiences
- Personal experience as a content creator or deep engagement with creator communities

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Clients
jobs.description:
Linden Lab develops platforms that empower people to create and connect through transformative virtual experiences. They are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own complex client product areas and drive measurable outcomes across their Desktop App, Desktop Web, and Mobile App surfaces, translating company vision into clear strategy and execution.

Responsibilities:
- Lead cross-functional teams through all phases of frontend and backend product development, owning end-to-end strategy and execution across Desktop App, Desktop Web, and Mobile App
- Shape product vision and strategy with product, design, engineering, and marketing, defining and driving client product roadmaps aligned to company objectives from discovery through delivery and optimization
- Drive weekly executive product reviews, communicating progress, surfacing tradeoffs, and presenting recommendations to support timely decisions
- Partner closely with Engineering, Program Management, Performance Marketing, and Strategic Insights to deliver measurable outcomes, including collaboration on APIs and platform capabilities to optimize Second Life’s backend infrastructure
- Own and optimize core client metrics including DAU, MAU, concurrency, retention, monetization, and acquisition using data-driven decision-making, experimentation, A/B testing, and user research
- Skill up to use AI models like Claude Projects to improve the Product process
- Identify and promote opportunities to leverage AI-powered tools and automation to streamline product workflows, improve analysis and experimentation, and increase the efficiency of cross-functional teams
- Apply iterative development practices to continuously improve product quality and operational efficiency while developing deep fluency in Second Life’s features, use cases, and community culture
- Communicate product initiatives and results across the company, including to leadership, while operating in a highly visible, executive-sponsored product area with sustained investment
- Work in a hybrid model from our San Francisco office in a fast-paced startup environment

Skills:
- Typically 8+ years of Product Management experience delivering consumer apps across platforms, with proven ownership of products through full lifecycle delivery in social, gaming, virtual world, or creator-driven environments
- Strong ability to define strategy, roadmaps, success metrics, and growth plans while leading cross-functional teams without direct authority in ambiguous environments
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting to leadership and driving alignment across partners
- Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience in experimentation, A/B testing, metrics-driven development, and optimization
- Solid understanding of modern software development lifecycles, client platforms (mobile and desktop), APIs, backend systems, and internal tools such as GitHub, with experience improving operational efficiency
- Capability with AI tools (e.g., LLMs, copilots, automation) to improve product discovery, prototyping, analysis, documentation, and team efficiency
- Ecosystem mindset, able to balance the needs of creators, residents and platform health with business goals when making product decisions
- Experience owning acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization goals in partnership with marketing and data teams
- Collaborative, self-directed, and organized problem-solver, comfortable managing competing priorities and healthy conflict
- Willingness to explore AI-driven methods for product development, process improvement, and customer experience, with familiarity in client-side software and virtual world environments

qa_bank.question: Why are you interested in this role?
qa_bank.answer: I like owning one number and the whole loop around it. At Brightpath I own growth for a 12M-user app, and I want to bring that same mix of experiments, research and shipping to a product whose users I would use myself.

qa_bank.question: Describe a product you launched end to end.
qa_bank.answer: At Tidewell I launched automated round-up savings. I interviewed 30 users, wrote the PRD, ran a fake-door test, shipped to 10 percent of users, and rolled it out after monthly active savers grew 47 percent over two quarters.

qa_bank.question: Tell us about a time you used data to change a decision.
qa_bank.answer: Our Brightpath paywall test showed a higher trial-start rate but lower week-4 retention. I proposed we judge on retained revenue instead, re-cut the results by cohort, and we shipped the variant that lost on trial starts and won on revenue by 6 percent.

qa_bank.question: How do you work with engineering and design?
qa_bank.answer: I write short briefs that start with the user problem and the metric, agree the scope with the engineering lead before design starts, and review work in progress weekly so nothing surprises anyone at launch.

qa_bank.question: What is your biggest weakness?
qa_bank.answer: I take on too much analysis myself. I now hand routine cuts to our data scientist, and I keep my own time for the decisions that need product judgment.

qa_bank.question: What are your salary expectations?
qa_bank.answer: I am looking for $170,000 to $195,000 base, and I am open to discussing total compensation for the right role.

qa_bank.question: Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?
qa_bank.answer: Yes. I am a U.S. citizen and do not need sponsorship now or in the future.

qa_bank.question: Where do you see yourself in three years?
qa_bank.answer: Leading a product area with a small team, still close to the users and the numbers, and having built something that moved a company-level metric.

body_paragraphs: A driver who signs up for a fuel card is trying to save money at the pump today, not read a tutorial. Getting that person from sign-up to a first discounted fill is the growth problem in this role, and it is the kind of problem I like: a short path, a clear metric and a lot of room to test.

At Brightpath I rebuilt onboarding and moved day-7 retention from 31% to 39%, and paywall tests I ran added $9M in recurring revenue. At Tidewell I cut drop-off in a bank-linking flow by 28% with a redesign and in-app education. My squad runs over 60 A/B tests a year, and I read the funnels and cohorts myself in SQL.

I have not worked in trucking, so I would start by riding along with drivers and fleet operators and talking to them directly, as I did with shoppers and savers in past roles. I would welcome a conversation about where onboarding loses people today and which fixes the team has already tried. I am based in Seattle and comfortable with the Palo Alto office.

autofill.why do you want to work at mudflap?: Mudflap sells a payment product to people who count every dollar, which makes growth work honest: if onboarding is confusing, drivers leave. I have done that kind of work in consumer fintech at Tidewell and in subscriptions at Brightpath. I want to apply it to a market I do not know yet and learn it by talking to drivers and fleet operators.
autofill.describe a time you improved activation: At Brightpath, new users were dropping before finishing a first session. We kept the test running for four weeks to confirm retention held.

autofill._default: I like owning growth for a consumer product: onboarding, activation and the experiments that prove what works. This role matches my work at Brightpath and Tidewell, and I would be glad to talk through the details and learn how Mudflap's customers use the product.

body_paragraphs: Link is the first moment a person trusts an app with their bank account, and a small change in how many people finish it has a large effect downstream. That is why the Link Growth role stands out to me. I have spent several years on exactly that step, from the consumer side, watching where people hesitate, where a bank connection fails and what it takes to bring them back.

At Tidewell I led bank linking for a budgeting app with 3M users and six aggregator integrations. Moving to a provider-agnostic API layer raised link success from 81% to 93%, and a redesigned flow with in-app education cut sign-up drop-off by 28%. I worked with security and legal on consent and data retention, and at Brightpath I built the experiment toolkit our squads use.

I have not yet worked on agent-based use cases, and I would like to learn how Link needs to change for them. I would welcome a conversation about where conversion is lowest today, how the team measures it and which experiments are queued next. I am based in Seattle and open to regular time in the San Francisco office.

autofill.why do you want to work at plaid?: Link is the step I know best. At Tidewell I owned bank linking for a consumer app, and I watched a few points of conversion decide whether a user ever saw value. Plaid owns that step for much of the industry. I want to work on conversion at that scale and learn how Link has to change as more AI-driven products use it.
autofill.describe a time you improved a conversio: At Tidewell, many users dropped between sign-up and linking their first account. We moved to a provider-agnostic aggregation layer so users fell back to a second provider when one failed, and redesigned the flow with in-app education. Link success rose from 81% to 93%, and sign-up to first-linked-account drop-off fell by 28%.
autofill.how do you work with legal and complianc: I bring them in at the spec stage rather than at launch. At Tidewell I worked with security and legal on consent screens, data retention rules and the SOC 2 evidence for consumer financial data. Early involvement meant fewer late changes, and we shipped the linking flow without reopening those decisions.
autofill._default: I like owning a conversion metric that sits at the front door of a product. This role matches my work on bank linking at Tidewell and experimentation tooling at Brightpath, and I would be glad to talk through the details.

body_paragraphs: I want to be direct about my fit: I have spent eight years on consumer apps, not enterprise software, and I have not worked on AI products. What draws me to the Growth role at Glean is the structure of the problem, which is getting individual users to value quickly and turning that use into habit across a team.

The parts I can bring are concrete. At Brightpath I built a self-serve experiment toolkit that cut test setup from 9 days to 2 and doubled the tests we run each quarter. I also led the notifications platform roadmap with three engineering teams, covering preference controls, throttling and delivery analytics. At Marlow Market I set event tracking standards that took analytics coverage from 60% to 95%.

The enterprise side, including connectors, admin buyers and team-level expansion, would be new to me, and I would expect to learn it from your customers and go-to-market team. If a growth product manager with strong experimentation habits is useful to you at this stage, I would welcome a conversation about where to start and what the team most needs in the first quarter.
